Basic Architecture\\\\nFor FFNs, we employ the DeepSeekMoE architecture (Dai et al., 2024). DeepSeekMoE has two\\\\nkey ideas: segmenting experts into finer granularity for higher expert specialization and more\\\\naccurate knowledge acquisition, and isolating some shared experts for mitigating kn\\\\n\\\\n[EXCERPT extracted-character range 24000:32000]\\\\nrder to mitigate this issue, we design a communication balance loss as follows:\\\\nLCommBal = 𝛼3\\\\n𝐷\\\\n∑︁\\\\n𝑖=1\\\\n𝑓′′\\\\n𝑖𝑃′′\\\\n𝑖,\\\\n(29)\\\\n𝑓′′\\\\n𝑖=\\\\n𝐷\\\\n𝑀𝑇\\\\n𝑇\\\\n∑︁\\\\n𝑡=1\\\\n1(Token 𝑡is sent to Device 𝑖),\\\\n(30)\\\\n𝑃′′\\\\n𝑖=\\\\n∑︁\\\\n𝑗∈E𝑖\\\\n𝑃𝑗,\\\\n(31)\\\\nwhere 𝛼3 is a hyper-parameter called communication balance factor. The device-limited routing\\\\nmechanism operates on the principle of ensuring that each device transmits at most 𝑀𝑇hidden\\\\nstates to other devices. Simultaneously, the communication balance loss is employed to encour-\\\\nage each device to receive around 𝑀𝑇hidden states from other devices. The communication\\\\nbalance loss guarantees a balanced exchange of information among devices, promoting efficient\\\\ncommunications.\\\\n2.2.4. Token-Dropping Strategy\\\\nWhile balance losses aim to encourage a balanced load, it is important to acknowledge that\\\\nthey cannot guarantee a strict load balance. In order to further mitigate the computation\\\\nwastage caused by unbalanced load, we introduce a device-level token-dropping strategy during\\\\ntraining. This approach first computes the average computational budget for each device, which\\\\nmeans that the capacity factor for each device is equivalent to 1.0. Then, inspired by Riquelme\\\\net al. (2021), we drop tokens with the lowest affinity scores on each device until reaching the\\\\ncomputational budget. In addition, we ensure that the tokens belonging to approximately 10%\\\\nof the training sequences will never be dropped. In this way, we can flexibly decide whether\\\\nto drop tokens during inference according to the efficiency requirements, and always ensure\\\\nconsistency between training and inference.\\\\n3. Pre-Training\\\\n3.1. Experimental Setups\\\\n3.1.1. Data Construction\\\\nWhile maintaining the same data processing stages as for DeepSeek 67B (DeepSeek-AI, 2024),\\\\nwe extend the amount of data and elevate the data quality. In order to enlarge our pre-training\\\\ncorpus, we explore the potential of the internet data and optimize our cleaning processes, thus\\\\nrecovering a large amount of mistakenly deleted data. Moreover, we incorporate more Chinese\\\\ndata, aiming to better leverage the corpus available on the Chinese internet. In addition to\\\\nthe amount of data, we also focus on the data quality. We enrich our pre-training corpus with\\\\nhigh-quality data from various sources, and meanwhile improve the quality-based filtering\\\\nalgorithm. The improved algorithm ensures that a large amount of non-beneficial data will\\\\nbe removed, while the valuable data will be mostly retained. In addition, we filter out the\\\\ncontentious content from our pre-training corpus to mitigate the data bias introduced from\\\\nspecific regional cultures. A detailed discussion about the influence of this filtering strategy is\\\\npresented in Appendix E.\\\\n11\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n--- PAGE 12 ---\\\\nWe adopt the same tokenizer as used in DeepSeek 67B, which is built based on the Byte-level\\\\nByte-Pair Encoding (BBPE) algorithm and has a vocabulary size of 100K. Our tokenized pre-\\\\ntraining corpus contains 8.1T tokens, where Chinese tokens are approximately 12% more than\\\\nEnglish ones.\\\\n3.1.2. Hyper-Parameters\\\\nModel Hyper-Parameters.\\\\nWe set the number of Transformer layers to 60 and the hidden\\\\ndimension to 5120. All learnable parameters are randomly initialized with a standard deviation\\\\nof 0.006. In MLA, we set the number of attention heads 𝑛ℎto 128 and the per-head dimension 𝑑ℎ\\\\nto 128. The KV compression dimension 𝑑𝑐is set to 512, and the query compression dimension\\\\n𝑑′\\\\n𝑐is set to 1536. For the decoupled queries and key, we set the per-head dimension 𝑑𝑅\\\\nℎto 64.\\\\nFollowing Dai et al. (2024), we substitute all FFNs except for the first layer with MoE layers.\\\\nEach MoE layer consists of 2 shared experts and 160 routed experts, where the intermediate\\\\nhidden dimension of each expert is 1536. Among the routed experts, 6 experts will be activated\\\\nfor each token. In addition, the low-rank compression and fine-grained expert segmentation\\\\nwill impact the output scale of a layer. Therefore, in practice, we employ additional RMS Norm\\\\nlayers after the compressed latent vectors, and multiply additional scaling factors at the width\\\\nbottlenecks (i.e., the compressed latent vectors and the intermediate hidden states of routed\\\\nexperts) to ensure stable training. Under this configuration, DeepSeek-V2 comprises 236B total\\\\nparameters, of which 21B are activated for each token.\\\\nTraining Hyper-Parameters.\\\\nWe employ the AdamW optimizer (Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017)\\\\nwith hyper-parameters set to 𝛽1 = 0.9, 𝛽2 = 0.95, and weight_decay = 0.1. The learning rate is\\\\nscheduled using a warmup-and-step-decay strategy (DeepSeek-AI, 2024). Initially, the learning\\\\nrate linearly increases from 0 to the maximum value during the first 2K steps. Subsequently,\\\\nthe learning rate is multiplied by 0.316 after training about 60% of tokens, and again by 0.316\\\\nafter training about 90% of tokens. The maximum learning rate is set to 2.4 × 10−4, and the\\\\ngradient clipping norm is set to 1.0. We also use a batch size scheduling strategy, where the\\\\nbatch size is gradually increased from 2304 to 9216 in the training of the first 225B tokens, and\\\\nthen keeps 9216 in the remaining training. We set the maximum sequence length to 4K, and\\\\ntrain DeepSeek-V2 on 8.1T tokens. We leverage pipeline parallelism to deploy different layers of\\\\na model on different devices, and for each layer, the routed experts will be uniformly deployed\\\\non 8 devices (𝐷= 8). As for the device-limited routing, each token will be sent to at most 3\\\\ndevices (𝑀= 3). As for balance losses, we set 𝛼1 to 0.003, 𝛼2 to 0.05, and 𝛼3 to 0.02. We employ\\\\nthe token-dropping strategy during training for acceleration, but do not drop any tokens for\\\\nevaluation.\\\\n3.1.3. Infrastructures\\\\nDeepSeek-V2 is trained based on the HAI-LLM framework (High-flyer, 2023), an efficient and\\\\nlight-weight training framework developed internally by our engineers. It employs a 16-way\\\\nzero-bubble pipeline parallelism (Qi et al., 2023), an 8-way expert parallelism (Lepikhin et al.,\\\\n2021), and ZeRO-1 data parallelism (Rajbhandari et al., 2020). Given that DeepSeek-V2 has\\\\nrelatively few activated parameters, and a portion of the operators are recomputed to save acti-\\\\nvation memory, it can be trained without the necessity of tensor parallelism, thereby decreasing\\\\nthe communication overhead. The number of attention heads needs to be divisible by the\\\\n   tensor-parallelism degree.\\\\n2. The total data size of model weights and key-value caches needs to be\\\\n   smaller than the tensor-parallelism degree multiplied by the amount\\\\n   of memory per Neuron core.\\\\n\\\\n   1. On Trn2, each Neuron core has 24GB of memory (with LNC2).\\\\n   2. On Inf2/Trn1, each Neuron core has 16GB of memory.\\\\n\\\\n3. The Neuron runtime supports the following tensor-parallelism degrees:\\\\n\\\\n   1. Trn2: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, and 64 (with LNC2)\\\\n   2. Inf2: 1, 2, 4, 8, and 24\\\\n   3. Trn1: 1, 2, 8, 16, and 32\\\\n\\\\nExamples\\\\n~~~~~~~~\\\\n\\\\n1. ``meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B`` has 32 attention heads, and when\\\\n   running at batch size 1 and bfloat16 precision, the model requires\\\\n   about 16GB memory. Therefore, a ``trn1.2xlarge`` with 32GB device\\\\n   memory is sufficient.\\\\n2. ``meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-70B`` has 64 attention heads, and when\\\\n   running at batch size 1 and bfloat16 precision, the model requires\\\\n   about 148GB memory. Therefore, it can run on 16 NeuronCores on one\\\\n   ``trn1.32xlarge`` using 256GB device memory.\\\\n\\\\n.. _nxdi-feature-guide-sequence-parallelism:\\\\n\\\\nSequence Parallelism\\\\n--------------------\\\\nSequence parallelism splits tensors across the sequence dimension to\\\\nimprove performance. This\\\\nmodule is also used in NxD Inference modeling code like Llama and\\\\nMixtral.\\\\n\\\\nNxD Inference supports the following sharding strategies\\\\nfor the KV cache used in the attention module:\\\\n\\\\n- ``CONVERT_TO_MHA`` — Transforms a GQA attention mechanism into a\\\\n  traditional MHA mechanism by replicating the K/V heads to evenly match\\\\n  the corresponding Q heads. This consumes more memory than would\\\\n  otherwise be used with other sharding mechanisms but works in all\\\\n  cases.\\\\n- ``REPLICATE_TO_TP_DEGREE`` — Transforms a GQA attention mechanism such\\\\n  that there is exactlyone K/V head per tp_degree through replication\\\\n  e.g. 8 K/V heads with tp_degree=32 results in 32 K/V heads. This is\\\\n  more memory efficient but does not work for all configurations. Q\\\\n  heads are padded interleaved to retain correct alignment between Q and\\\\n  K/V heads.\\\\n\\\\nThe NeuronAttentionBase module uses ``REPLICATE_TO_TP_DEGREE`` by\\\\ndefault. If the TP degree isn't divisible by the number of KV heads,\\\\nNeuronAttentionBase uses ``CONVERT_TO_MHA``.\\\\n\\\\n.. _nxdi_async_mode_feature_guide:\\\\n\\\\nAsyncronous Runtime Support\\\\n---------------------------\\\\n\\\\nNxD Inference offers certain model configurations to be run with Asyncronous Runtime Mode (Async mode).\\\\nAsync mode allows NxD Inference to parallelize CPU logic with Neuron (NEFF) logic. As a result, any CPU overheads\\\\nwithin NxDI that exist between sequential model executions (ex. autoregressive loop in LLMs) are almost fully\\\\neliminated. This reduces latency anywhere from 5% to 20% based on the model configuration.\\\\n\\\\nThis feature can be enabled with by setting ``async_mode`` to ``True`` in ``NeuronConfig``.\\\\n\\\\nTo use Async mode, a model configuration must meet the following prerequisites:\\\\n- On-device sampling is enabled.\\\\n- If speculation is enabled, fused speculation must also be enabled.\\\\n\\\\nIt is highly recommended to set ``async_mode`` to ``True`` for every other case, since it offers a latency reduction.\\\\nFurthermore, this feature is a purely runtime feature, so if you have a previously compiled model, and its configuration\\\\ndoesn't fall under the unsupported case, ``async_mode`` will likely be able to improve performance.\\\\n\\\\n.. note::\\\\n    If you are using vLLM, this feature works independently of vLLM's Async Engine. As a result, ``async_mode`` can be enabled\\\\n    whether vLLM is used or not.\\\\n\\\\n.. _nxdi_prefix_caching:\\\\n\\\\nPrefix Caching Support\\\\n----------------------\\\\n\\\\nPrefix caching is a performance optimization technique where prompts in multiple requests sharing the same prefix can reuse the\\\\npreviously computed KV cache. When context encoding a prompt that starts with a previously computed prefix, the encoding of the\\\\nprefix tokens will be skipped and the corresponding KV Cache will be fetched and used for encoding the rest of the tokens (suffix).\\\\nThe performance benefit comes from the time saved by re-using the KV Cache instead of re-encoding the prefix tokens. NxD Inference\\\\nsupports prefix caching during context encoding. To store KV cache and match to prefix efficiently, NxD Inference uses block KV Cache\\\\nlayout for prefix caching. NxD Inference does not implement its own cache eviction, memory management, or prefix hashing for matches.\\\\nInstead, it requires external management of the block KV cache and expects active block tables and slot mappings to be provided with\\\\neach generation request. This feature integrates with vLLM by enabling automatic prefix caching, which manages the block tables,\\\\nhandles automatic prefix matching across prompts, and performs cache evictions. More on automatic prefix caching support on vLLM\\\\ncan be found `here <https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/design/v1/prefix_caching.html>`__.\\\\n\\\\nTo enable prefix caching with NxD Inference, set ``is_prefix_caching=True`` in NeuronConfig along with configurations for\\\\nblock KV cache layout.\\\\n\\\\n::\\\\n\\\\n    neuron_config = NeuronConfig(\\\\n        is_prefix_caching=True,\\\\n        is_block_kv_layout=True,\\\\n        pa_num_blocks=1024,\\\\n        pa_block_size=32,\\\\n    )\\\\n\\\\n``is_block_kv_layout=True`` and ``is_prefix_caching=True`` are set in NeuronConfig to enable block KV Cache layout and enable\\\\nprefix caching. The first two dimensions of the KV cache are set to the number of blocks and block size, respectively. These\\\\nconfigurations are specified using ``pa_num_blocks`` and ``pa_block_size`` in NeuronConfig. For optimal performance with Neuron,\\\\nit's recommended to set ``pa_block_size=32``. The minimum required ``pa_num_blocks`` to be initialized is\\\\n``(batch_size * max_model_len) / pa_block_size`` However, it is recommended to initialize more blocks than the required minimum\\\\nto accommodate caching of common prefixes. The higher the number of blocks, the greater the likelihood of cache hits, as fewer\\\\ncache evictions will occur. NxD Inference does not currently provide an automated solution to determine the maximum number of\\\\nKV Cache blocks that can be initialized in HBM without exceeding available memory space. Customers are advised to experiment with\\\\nincreasing the number of blocks that balances the cache hit rate and memory taken. Any memory taken by increasing the cache will\\\\nimpact the batch sizes and sequence lengths that can be supported, so customers are sugggested to pick the correct number of blocks\\\\nconsidering these trade offs and the specific inference workload they plan to run in production.\\\\n\\\\nNxD Inference does not use paged attention for prefix caching. Instead, it follows a different process:\\\\nfirst gathering the block KV cache using the block table, then converting it to a flat KV cache layout, computing attention, and \\\\nfinally scattering the computed cache back to the block KV cache layout. This approach introduces overhead during\\\\ntoken generation requests due to layout conversions, which can negatively impact performance as the ``max_model_len`` increases.\\\\n\\\\n.. _bucketing-with-prefix-caching:\\\\n\\\\nBucketing with Prefix Caching\\\\n~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\\\\n\\\\nPrefix caching handles both the prefix (cache hit) and suffix (no cache hit) portions of input prompts during context encoding.\\\\nA two-dimensional bucketing system has been introduced to support context encoding when prefix caching is enabled. This system\\\\nuses separate dimensions corresponding to the prefix and suffix (non cache-hit portion) of the input prompts. In contrast,\\\\ntoken generation still uses one-dimensional bucketing based on the maximum sequence length.\\\\n\\\\nWhen bucketing is enabled, NxD Inference creates prefill (suffix) buckets (covering suffix portion) starting with powers of 2,\\\\nranging from 512 up to the maximum context length. The prefix buckets mirror the prefill buckets, with one key difference: a special\\\\nprefix bucket of size 0 is added to handle requests with no cache hits. NxD Inference then creates a two-dimensional grid of all prefill\\\\nand prefix bucket combinations, which represents the effective set of buckets during context encoding. During request processing,\\\\nNxD Inference first identifies the smallest prefill bucket that can accommodate the largest suffix portion of the input prompts.\\\\nIf prefill padding is needed, NxD Inference prioritizes moving tokens from the prefix's end to the prefill bucket before adding padding.\\\\nIt then determines the smallest prefix bucket that can fit the largest prefix across prompts. These two dimensions together determine\\\\nthe final (prefill, prefix) bucket combination used to serve the context encoding request.\\\\n\\\\nYou can configure specific buckets to optimize inference based on the expected distribution of prefix lengths, input lengths, and\\\\noutput lengths for your model. In NeuronConfig, set ``enable_bucketing=True``, and provide a list of bucket sizes in\\\\n``context_encoding_buckets``, ``prefix_buckets`` and/or ``token_generation_buckets``. ``context_encoding_buckets`` corresponds to prefill\\\\nbuckets when prefix caching is enabled.\\\\n\\\\n::\\\\n\\\\n    neuron_config = NeuronConfig(\\\\n        enable_bucketing=True,\\\\n        context_encoding_buckets=[512, 1024, 2048],\\\\n        prefix_buckets=[512, 1024]\\\\n        token_generation_buckets=[2048]\\\\n    )\\\\n\\\\nExamples\\\\n^^^^^^^^\\\\n\\\\nFor ``context_encoding_buckets=[512, 1024, 2048]`` and ``prefix_buckets=[512, 1024]``\\\\n\\\\nFor requests with:\\\\n\\\\n- Input prompt of size 1000 with no prefix, NxDI uses prefill bucket as 1024 and prefix bucket as 0.\\\\n- Input prompt of size 800 with 128 as the prefix size, and remaining 672 as the suffix size, NxDI first selects 1024\\\\n  as the prefill bucket\\\\n\\\\n[EXCERPT extracted-character range 40000:48000]\\\\nix size, NxDI selects 512 as the\\\\n  prefill bucket. Remaining 192 prefill slots are filled up by moving 192 tokens from the end of prefix to the suffix part.\\\\n  Effective prefix length now becomes 1088 which is larger than the largest prefix bucket of 1024. This leads to exception\\\\n  during the request processing.\\\\n\\\\nThe two-dimensional bucketing system exponentially increases the number of context encoding buckets. Therefore, users should exercise caution\\\\nwhen using auto-bucketing with large context lengths. It is recommended to limit the granularity of prefix buckets based on your\\\\nspecific workload requirements.\\\\n\\\\nFor detailed examples of prefix caching with NxD Inference and vLLM, see :ref:`/libraries/nxd-inference/tutorials/trn2-llama3.3-70b-apc-tutorial.ipynb`.\\\\n\\\\nMulti-LoRA Serving\\\\n------------------\\\\n\\\\nNxD Inference supports serving with multiple LoRA adapters will be used by users to specify the LoRA adapter for serving at runtime and by NxDI for model compilation.\\\\n\\\\nThe maximum number of concurrent LoRA adapters in device memory and host memory for serving are specified by ``max_loras`` and ``max_cpu_loras``, respectively.\\\\nWhen ``dynamic_multi_lora=False``, all the LoRA adapters must be fully pre-loaded into device memory before the serving process begins.\\\\nDynamic multi-LoRA serving is enabled by ``dynamic_multi_lora=True``, which loads more LoRA adapters to host memory and dynamically swaps them from CPU to HBM at runtime according to user requests.\\\\nNxD Inference can quantize the base model for multi-LoRA serving with ``base_model_quantized=True``. \\\\nRefer to :ref:`nxd-inference-api-guide-neuron-config` for setting the :ref:`/libraries/nxd-inference/tutorials/trn2-llama3.1-8b-multi-lora-tutorial.ipynb`.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nMaximum number of LoRA adapters supported in device memory\\\\n~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~\\\\n\\\\nThe LoRA adapter size is much smaller than the base model, but its weights still consumes non-negligible on-device memory. \\\\nThe maximum number of LoRA adapters that can be concurrently supported in the device memory depends on the base model, the LoRA rank, the reserved HBM size for LoRA adapters, and how the LoRA adapters are sharded across TP groups.\\\\n\\\\nSuppose a Trainium instance is used for multi-LoRA serving and the reserved HBM size on each neuron core for LoRA adapters is 2GB.\\\\nEach LoRA adapter has two parts, LoRA A and LoRA B, and only one of them can be partitioned with tensor parallelism and the other is just Linear layer.\\\\nWe analyze the maximum number of LoRA adapters supported in the device memory under two cases: 1/ the linear layer is duplicated, and 2/ the linear layer is sharded.\\\\nThese two cases can be specified by ``lora_shard_linear_layer`` in ``LoraServingConfig``.\\\\n\\\\nWhen the linear layer is duplicated\\\\n^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^\\\\n\\\\nThe weight size of a LoRA adapter on each device is around half of the total LoRA adapter size in this case.\\\\nWhen the base model is Llama3.1 8B, the LoRA adapter checkpoint size with LoRA rank 16 in BF16 is around 170MB. \\\\nBecause ``2GB / (170MB / 2) = 23``, the maximum number of concurrent LoRA adapters is 23.\\\\nWhen the base model is Llama3.3 70B, the LoRA adapter checkpoint size with LoRA rank 16 in BF16 is around 830MB and we can set ``max_loras=4``.\\\\nWe analyze the maximum number of LoRA adapters supported in NxD inference under two cases: the linear layer is duplicated and the linear layer is sharded.\\\\nThese two cases can be specified by ``lora_shard_linear_layer`` in ``LoraServingConfig``.\\\\n\\\\n.. list-table::\\\\n    :widths: auto\\\\n    :header-rows: 1 \\\\n    :stub-columns: 1    \\\\n    :align: left\\\\n      \\\\n    *   - 32\\\\n        - 38\\\\n\\\\n.. _nxdi_di_feature_guide:\\\\n\\\\nDisaggregated Inference [BETA]\\\\n------------------------------\\\\n\\\\nDisaggregated Inference is an LLM serving architecture separates the prefill and decode phases of inference onto different hardware resources.\\\\nSeparating the compute intensive prefill phase from the memory bandwidth intensive decode phase can improve the LLM serving experience by\\\\n\\\\n1. Removing prefill interruptions to decode from continuous batching to reduce inter token latency (ITL). These gains can be used to\\\\nachieve higher throughput by running with a higher decode batch size while staying under Service Level Objectives (SLO).\\\\n\\\\n2. Adapt to changing traffic patterns while still remaining under application SLOs.\\\\n\\\\n3. Enable independent scaling of resources and parallelism strategies for prefill (compute bound) and decode (memory bound).\\\\n\\\\nSee the :ref:`Disaggregated Inference Developer Guide<n\\\", \\\"excerpt_ranges\\\": [[4000, 8000], [20000, 24000], [28000, 39411], [40000, 48000]], \\\"range_unit\\\": \\\"zero-based half-open characters in extracted text\\\", \\\"extracted_characters\\\": 48117, \\\"selected_characters\\\": 27411, \\\"extraction\\\": \\\"UTF-8 text\\\", \\\"selection_reason\\\": \\\"Ranked 4000-character windows by current entry title/tags/questions and algorithm/mechanism keywords; ties retain source order.\\\"}, {\\\"path\\\": \\\"references/S-GOTO/fulltext.txt\\\", \\\"sha256\\\": \\\"fa2baae04f808da45e7ba1b55fe81877af122ebae875c3efc9b19a0f85ff6a88\\\", \\\"reading_scope\\\": \\\"excerpt\\\", \\\"category\\\": \\\"source_original\\\", \\\"content\\\": \\\"[EXCERPT extracted-character range 0:4000]\\\\n=== PDF page 1 ===\\\\nAnatomy of High-Performance Matrix\\\\nMultiplication\\\\nKAZUSHIGE GOTO\\\\nThe University of Texas at Austin\\\\nand\\\\nROBERT A. VAN DE GEIJN\\\\nThe University of Texas at Austin\\\\nWe present the basic principles which underlie the high-performance implementation of the matrix-\\\\nmatrix multiplication that is part of the widely used GotoBLAS library.\\\\nDesign decisions are\\\\njustiﬁed by successively reﬁning a model of architectures with multilevel memories. A simple but\\\\neﬀective algorithm for executing this operation results. Implementations on a broad selection of\\\\narchitectures are shown to achieve near-peak performance.\\\\nCategories and Subject Descriptors: G.4 [Mathematical Software]: —Eﬃciency\\\\nGeneral Terms: Algorithms;Performance\\\\nAdditional Key Words and Phrases: linear algebra, matrix multiplication, basic linear algebra\\\\nsubprogrms\\\\n1.\\\\nINTRODUCTION\\\\nImplementing matrix multiplication so that near-optimal performance is attained\\\\nrequires a thorough understanding of how the operation must be layered at the\\\\nmacro level in combination with careful engineering of high-performance kernels\\\\nat the micro level. This paper primarily addresses the macro issues, namely how\\\\nto exploit a high-performance “inner-kernel”, more so than the the micro issues\\\\nrelated to the design and engineering of that “inner-kernel”.\\\\nIn [Gunnels et al. 2001] a layered approach to the implementation of matrix\\\\nmultiplication was reported. The approach was shown to optimally amortize the\\\\nrequired movement of data between two adjacent memory layers of an architecture\\\\nwith a complex multi-level memory. A second architectural consideration relates to the\\\\npage management system. For our discussion it suﬃces to consider that a typical\\\\nmodern architecture uses virtual memory so that the size of usable memory is not\\\\nconstrained by the size of the physical memory: Memory is partitioned into pages\\\\n2Note that optimizing the similar problem mckc/(2mc +2kc) under the constraint that mckc ≤K\\\\nis the problem of maximizing the area of a rectangle while minimizing the perimeter, the solution\\\\nof which is mc = kc.\\\\nWe don’t give an exact solution to the stated problem since there are\\\\npractical issues that also inﬂuence mc and kc.\\\\nACM Transactions on Mathematical Software, Vol. V, No. N, Month 20YY.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n=== PDF page 9 ===\\\\nAnatomy of High-Performance Matrix Multiplication\\\\n·\\\\n9\\\\nof some (often ﬁxed) prescribed size. A table, referred to as the page table maps\\\\nvirtual addresses to physical addresses and keeps track of whether a page is in\\\\nmemory or on disk. The problem is that this table itself is stored in memory, which\\\\nadds additional memory access costs to perform virtual to physical translations.\\\\nTo overcome this, a smaller table, the Translation Look-aside Buﬀer (TLB), that\\\\nstores information about the most recently used pages, is kept. Whenever a virtual\\\\naddress is found in the TLB, the translation is fast. Whenever it is not found (a\\\\nTLB miss occurs), the page table is consulted and the resulting entry is moved\\\\nfrom the page table to the TLB. In other words, the TLB is a cache for the page\\\\ntable. More recently, a level 2 TLB has been introduced into some architectures\\\\nfor reasons similar to those that motivated the introduction of an L2 cache.\\\\nThe most signiﬁcant diﬀerence between a cache miss and a TLB miss is that a\\\\ncache miss does not necessarily stall the CPU. A small number of cache misses can\\\\nbe tolerated by using algorithmic prefetching techniques as long as the data can be\\\\nread fast enough from the memory where it does exist and arrives at the CPU by\\\\nthe time it is needed for computation. A TLB miss, by contrast, causes the CPU\\\\nto stall until the TLB has been updated with the new address. In other words,\\\\nprefetching can mask a cache miss but not a TLB miss.\\\\nThe existence of the TLB means that additional assumptions must be met:\\\\nAssumption (d). The dimensions mc, kc are small enough so that A, nr columns\\\\nfrom B (Bj) and nr column from C (Cj) are simultaneously addressable by the\\\\nTLB so that during the computation Cj := ABj + Cj no TLB misses occur.\\\\nAssumption (e). If A is addressed by the TLB, it remains so until no longer\\\\nneeded.\\\\n4.2.3\\\\nPacking. The fundamental problem now is that A is typically a submatrix\\\\nof a larger matrix, and therefore is not contiguous in memory. This in turn means\\\\nthat addressing it requires many more than the minimal number of TLB entries.\\\\nThe solution is to pack A in a contiguous work array, ˜A. Parameters mc and kc\\\\nare then chosen so that ˜A, Bj, and Cj all ﬁt in the L2 cache and are addressable\\\\nby the TLB.\\\\nCase 1: The TLB is the limiting factor. Let us assume that there are T TLB\\\\nentries available, and let T ˜\\\\nA, TBj, and TCj equal the number of TLB entries devoted\\\\nto ˜A, Bj, and Cj, respectively. Then\\\\nT ˜\\\\nA + 2(TBj + TCj) ≤T.\\\\nThe reason for the factor two is that when the next blocks of columns Bj+1 and\\\\nCj+1 are ﬁrst addressed, the TLB entries that address them should replace those\\\\nthat were used for Bj and Cj. However, upon completion of Cj := ˜ABj + Cj some\\\\nTLB entries related to ˜A will be the least recently used, and will likely be replaced\\\\nby those that address Bj+1 and Cj+1. The factor two allows entries related to Bj\\\\nand Cj to coexist with those for ˜A, Bj+1 and Cj+1 and by the time Bj+2 and Cj+2\\\\nare ﬁrst addressed, it will be the entries related to Bj and Cj that will be least\\\\nrecently used and therefore replaced.\\\\nThe packing of A into ˜A, if done carefully, needs not to create a substantial\\\\noverhead beyond what is already exposed from the loading of A into the L2 cache\\\\nACM Transactions on Mathematical Software, Vol. V, No. N, Month 20YY.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n=== PDF page 10 ===\\\\n10\\\\n·\\\\nKazushige Goto and Robert A. van de Geijn\\\\nand TLB. Thus, we expect\\\\ngepdot-based implementations to achieve worse performance than the other four\\\\noptions.\\\\nComparing the pair of algorithms in Figs. 8 and 9 the primary diﬀerence is that\\\\nthe former packs B and streams elements of C from and to main memory, while\\\\nthe latter streams B from main memory, computes C in a temporary buﬀer, and\\\\nﬁnally unpacks by adding this temporary result to C. Thus the algorithm in Fig. 8 can\\\\nbe expected to be superior to all the other presented options.\\\\nDue to the level of eﬀort that is required to implement kernels like gebp, gepb,\\\\nand gepdot, we focus on the algorithm in Fig. 8 throughout the remainder of this\\\\npaper.\\\\nWe stress that the conclusions in this subsection are continguent on the observa-\\\\ntion that on essentially all current processors there is an advantage to blocking for\\\\nthe L2 cache. Introduction\\\\nCurrent state-of-the-art Convolutional Neural Networks\\\\n(CNNs) are not well suited for use on mobile devices. Since\\\\nthe advent of AlexNet [20], modern CNNs have primarily\\\\nbeen appraised according to classiﬁcation / detection accu-\\\\nracy. Thus network architectures have evolved without re-\\\\ngard to model complexity and computational efﬁciency. On\\\\nthe other hand, successful deployment of CNNs on mobile\\\\nplatforms such as smartphones, AR/VR devices (HoloLens,\\\\nDaydream), and drones require small model sizes to accom-\\\\nmodate limited on-device memory, and low latency to main-\\\\ntain user engagement. This has led to a burgeoning ﬁeld of\\\\nresearch that focuses on reducing the model size and infer-\\\\nence time of CNNs with minimal accuracy losses.\\\\nApproaches in this ﬁeld roughly fall into two cate-\\\\ngories. The ﬁrst category, exempliﬁed by MobileNet [10],\\\\nSqueezeNet [16], ShufﬂeNet [32], and DenseNet [11], de-\\\\nsigns novel network architectures that exploit computation\\\\n/ memory efﬁcient operations. The second category quan-\\\\ntizes the weights and / or activations of a CNN from 32\\\\nbit ﬂoating point into lower bit-depth representations. This\\\\nmethodology, embraced by approaches such as Ternary\\\\nweight networks (TWN [22]), Binary Neural Networks\\\\n(BNN [14]), XNOR-net [27], and more [8, 21, 26, 33, 34,\\\\n35], is the focus of our investigation. Despite their abun-\\\\ndance, current quantization approaches are lacking in two\\\\nrespects when it comes to trading off latency with accuracy.\\\\nFirst, prior approaches have not been evaluated on a\\\\nreasonable baseline architecture. The most common base-\\\\nline architectures, AlexNet [20], VGG [28] and GoogleNet\\\\n[29], are all over-parameterized by design in order to extract\\\\nmarginal accuracy improvements. Therefore, it is easy to\\\\nobtain sizable compression of these architectures, reducing\\\\nquantization experiments on these architectures to proof-\\\\nof-concepts at best. Instead, a more meaningful challenge\\\\nwould be to quantize model architectures that are already ef-\\\\nﬁcient at trading off latency with accuracy, e.g. MobileNets.\\\\nSecond, many quantization approaches do not deliver\\\\nveriﬁable efﬁciency improvements on real hardware. Ap-\\\\nproaches that quantize only the weights ([2, 4, 8, 33]) are\\\\nprimarily concerned with on-device storage and less with\\\\ncomputational efﬁciency. Notable exceptions are binary,\\\\nternary and bit-shift networks [14, 22, 27].\\\\nThese latter\\\\napproaches employ weights that are either 0 or powers of\\\\n2, which allow multiplication to be implemented by bit\\\\nshifts. For ex-\\\\nample, if we use RSHL to implement the division −12/23,\\\\nthe result will be −1 whereas it should be −2 with “round\\\\nto nearest”. A\\\\ncorrect round-to-nearest right-shift can still be implemented\\\\nusing RSHL but with suitable ﬁx-up arithmetic around it11.\\\\nFor efﬁcient NEON implementation of the matrix mul-\\\\ntiplication’s core accumulation, we use the following trick.\\\\nIn the multiply-add operation in (10), we ﬁrst change the\\\\noperands’ type from uint8 to int8 (which can be done by\\\\nsubtracting 128 from the quantized values and zero-points).\\\\nThus the core multiply-add becomes\\\\nint32 += int8 * int8.\\\\n(B.1)\\\\nAs mentioned in section 3, with a minor tweak of the quan-\\\\ntized training process, we can ensure that the weights, once\\\\nquantized as int8 values, never take the value −128. Hence,\\\\nthe product in (B.1) is never −128 ∗−128, and is there-\\\\nfore always less than 214 in absolute value. This allows the use of an 8-way SIMD multi-\\\\nplication (SMULL on int8 operands), followed by an 8-way\\\\nSIMD multiply-add (SMLAL on int8 operands), followed\\\\nby a pairwise-add-and-accumulate into the int32 accumula-\\\\ntors (SADALP)12.\\\\nC. Out of 122 recent scientiﬁc papers published at PLDI, ASPLOS,\\\\nISMM, TOPLAS, and TACO, as many as 65 included experimental evaluation that quantiﬁed a performance\\\\nchange using a ratio of execution times. Unfortunately, few of these papers evaluated their results with the\\\\nlevel of rigour that has come to be expected in other experimental sciences. The uncertainty of measured\\\\nresults was largely ignored. Scarcely any of the papers mentioned uncertainty in the ratio of the mean exe-\\\\ncution times, and most did not even mention uncertainty in the two means themselves. Furthermore, most\\\\nof the papers failed to address the non-deterministic execution of computer programs (caused by factors such\\\\nas memory placement, for example), and none addressed non-deterministic compilation (when a compiler\\\\ncreates different binaries from the same sources, which differ in performance, for example again because\\\\nof impact on memory placement). It turns out that the statistical methods presented in the computer sys-\\\\ntems performance evaluation literature for the design and summary of experiments do not readily allow this\\\\neither. This poses a hazard to the repeatability, reproducibility and even validity of quantitative results.\\\\nInspired by statistical methods used in other ﬁelds of science, and building on results in statistics that\\\\ndid not make it to introductory textbooks, we present a statistical model that allows us both to quantify\\\\nuncertainty in the ratio of (execution time) means and to design experiments with a rigorous treatment of\\\\nthose multiple sources of non-determinism that might impact measured performance. Better still, under\\\\nour framework summaries can be as simple as “system A is faster than system B by 5.5% ± 2.5%, with\\\\n95% conﬁdence”, a more natural statement than those derived from typical current practice, which are often\\\\nmisinterpreted.\\\\nCategories and Subject Descriptors: D.2.8 [Software Engineering]: Metrics—Performance measures; D.3.4\\\\n[Programming Languages]: Processors—Run-time environments\\\\nGeneral Terms: Experimentation, Measurement, Performance\\\\nAdditional Key Words and Phrases: statistical methods, random effects, effect size\\\\n1. INTRODUCTION\\\\nQuantiﬁcation of performance change is a common task in experimental computer sci-\\\\nence. Out of all 122 papers published in ASPLOS, ISMM, PLDI, TACO and TOPLAS in\\\\n2011 up to 2nd August, 65 included empirical evaluation that quantiﬁed performance\\\\nchange by giving the ratio of execution times (for example, speed-ups of optimisations,\\\\nor overheads of new techniques). Quantiﬁcation of performance change is also part of\\\\nthe software development process (for example, detecting performance regressions),\\\\nboth open-source and commercial.\\\\nExecution times for quantiﬁcation are obtained by running benchmark applications\\\\nusing the two systems to compare. Computer systems are becoming more complex and\\\\nincreasingly resemble the direct products of nature observed by physicists and natu-\\\\nral scientists — an overwhelming number of factors inﬂuence performance. Some are\\\\nunknown, some are out of the experimenter’s control, and some are non-deterministic.\\\\nRepeated executions of the same benchmark on the same system, even when the exper-\\\\nimenter does everything possible to enforce the same conditions, always report slightly\\\\ndifferent execution times. This is even more pronounced if the same experiment is re-\\\\npeated by an independent experimenter using different equipment. Thus, for credible\\\\nAuthor’s addresses: T. Kalibera (R.E. Jones), School of Computing, University of Kent, Canterbury, CT2 7NF,\\\\nUK.\\\\nA preliminary version of a portion of this work was presented at the Third European Performance Engineering\\\\nWorkshop.\\\\narXiv:2007.10899v1  [s\\\\n\\\\n[EXCERPT extracted-character range 32000:36000]\\\\ner detail in Section 3.2). Jain\\\\n[1991] and Lilja [2000] suggest using Student’s t-test for unequal variances (or the cor-\\\\nresponding interval). Georges et al. [2007] additionally recommend (an interval based\\\\non) the z-test for sample sizes over 30. Georges et al. also suggest working with sample\\\\nmeans of measurements from individual executions, instead of with the measurements\\\\nthemselves. The corresponding test/interval is hence only for these sample means. An\\\\nalternative solution that is sometimes used, but not part of their recommendation, is\\\\nto join all the measurements from the different executions and treat them as coming\\\\nfrom a one-level experiment.\\\\nLilja [2000] and particularly Jain [1991] then describe analysis of variance (ANOVA)\\\\nmethods to summarize experiments where multiple ﬁxed factors are varied (i.e. pro-\\\\ncessor, memory size, etc.). Georges et al. [2007] summarizes also some of the ANOVA\\\\nmethods from [Lilja 2000], but does not recommend it for use in (Java) performance\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n=== PDF page 9 ===\\\\nQuantifying Performance Changes with Effect Size Conﬁdence Intervals\\\\n9\\\\nevaluations as the outputs are too hard to understand and doing all the measurements\\\\nto provide the inputs is too time consuming. We do not address these types of factors\\\\n(‘ﬁxed effects’) in this work, but our method should be extensible to do so.\\\\nThe summarisation method that Georges et al. [2008] recommends for the replay\\\\ncompilation design leads to a test/interval based on paired t-test. The inputs are dif-\\\\nferences of means obtained from the old and new systems, averaging over multiple ex-\\\\necutions with a given compilation plan. We do not address paired comparisons in this\\\\nwork, but most of our criticism of the recommended quantiﬁcation using the test/inter-\\\\nval we mention later applies to it as well.\\\\n3. WHAT IS WRONG WITH THE CURRENTLY PROPOSED METHODS\\\\nEven though the current recommended best practice for quantiﬁcation of performance\\\\nchange by [Jain 1991], [Lilja 2000], and [Georges et al. 2007] is ahead of the pitiful\\\\npractice in the ﬁeld, it has a number of problems.\\\\n3.1. Experiment Design\\\\nRepetition of executions (and measurements) is not enough. It is necessary to include\\\\nall inherently random factors in the experiment, and hence to repeat experiments at\\\\nlevel(s) even higher than execution of the benchmark. For example, randomized com-\\\\npilation necessitates both compilation and running the experiments for different bina-\\\\nries. We have found this to be essential in our earlier work with the GNU C++ Com-\\\\npiler when benchmarking CORBA middleware and when benchmarking applications\\\\nwithin the Mono platform [Kalibera and Tuma 2006]. The empirical evaluation in this\\\\npaper conﬁrms this need on the Mono platform. Furthermore, we need to randomize\\\\nand include additional (non-random) factors that it does not make sense to ﬁx. These\\\\nfactors can arise from the operating system or the language environment. Mytkowicz\\\\net al. [2009] provide evidence that unexpected factors such as the size of UNIX process\\\\nenvironment or the linking order can impact performance. Gu et al. [2004] observed\\\\na performance impact of the names of identiﬁers in the source code. It is obvious that\\\\nmany additional factors of this kind have not yet been discovered to have signiﬁcant\\\\nperformance impact, so they cannot be really ﬁxed in experiments. Sufﬁcient random-\\\\nization, called for by Mytkowicz et al. [2009], is hence necessary. Curtsinger and Berger\\\\n[2012] provide a randomization tool applicable to applications studied in [Mytkowicz\\\\net al. 2009].\\\\nNote in particular that randomization of identiﬁer names or linking order leads in\\\\nturn again to randomized compilation/building. Repeating compilation or repeating at\\\\nan even higher level can be very expensive, because large systems take long to compile.\\\\nRepeating too many times is a waste of resources, but repeating too few times under-\\\\nmines repeatability and validity. Hence, a good experiment design method should also\\\\nallow the researcher to \\\\n\\\\n[EXCERPT extracted-character range 48000:52000]\\\\nting a conﬁdence interval for a metric that measures the difference in two\\\\nsystems is a known concept in statistics. Such a metric is called the effect size and\\\\nhence the effect size conﬁdence interval. Effect size conﬁdence intervals have been pro-\\\\nposed for quantiﬁcation as a replacement for signiﬁcance methods in psychology [Co-\\\\nhen 1994], education [Coe 2002], medicine, bio-medicine, and biology [Nakagawa and\\\\nCuthill 2007]. The change in statistical methods is not smooth, but evidence can be\\\\nfound that effect size is already being used, at least to some extent, in medicine [Bland\\\\nand Altman 2000] and psychology [Dunleavy et al. 2006]. To support the change, the\\\\nuse of effect size has sometimes been made an ofﬁcial requirement (Hill and Thompson\\\\n[2005] list 23 journals mostly in psychology and education that require reporting effect\\\\nsize, and the American Psychological Association [2001] requires it in its Publication\\\\nManual).\\\\n2In statistical texts, one can say also ‘n factors’, but we refrain from doing so here to avoid confusion with\\\\nthe informal meaning of a ‘factor’ used throughout the text. In our text, a ‘factor’ refers to a technical/real\\\\ncause that may impact performance and a ‘way’ refers to a statistical model of (some of) such causes.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n=== PDF page 13 ===\\\\nQuantifying Performance Changes with Effect Size Conﬁdence Intervals\\\\n13\\\\nThere are different metrics used for measure the effect size in different ﬁelds and\\\\none of them is the ratio of means. There are statistical methods for interval construc-\\\\ntion, although they did not make it to introductory textbooks (more information and\\\\nreferences can be found in [Beyene and Moineddin 2005; Schaarschmidt 2007; Dilba\\\\net al. 2007]). From several available methods, we have a closer look at two. One is\\\\nbased on statistical simulation (bootstrap) [Davison and Hinkley 1997]. The other is\\\\nbased on Fieller’s theorem [Fieller 1954], which gives a conﬁdence interval for the ratio\\\\nof means of normally distributed variables. We show how both methods can be applied\\\\nin the experimental design we propose, and empirically evaluate them.\\\\n4.3. Related Efforts\\\\nSome of the things we propose here have been proposed earlier in computer science,\\\\nbut have not been widely adopted.\\\\nA bootstrap-based method for construction of conﬁdence intervals is being used in\\\\nthe Haskell community, supported by the Criterion benchmarking library [O’Sullivan\\\\n2009]. The library is for measuring performance of one system only in single-level\\\\nexperiments. Apart from using robust methods it has also the advantage of detecting\\\\noutliers and auto-corellation of the data. The tool is based on [Boyer 2008].\\\\nConﬁdence interval for speed-up has been proposed by Luo and John [2004] in\\\\nthe context of processor simulation. The uncertainty does not come from random ef-\\\\nfects, but rather from random sub-sampling – only randomly chosen execution inter-\\\\nvals from the whole application execution are simulated, the same intervals in both\\\\nof the systems to compare. The conﬁdence interval proposed for this problem comes\\\\nfrom [Cochran 1977], it is a parametric interval based on asymptotic normality of not\\\\nonly the means, but also their ratio, which is only possible for large samples. The\\\\nmethod by Fieller [1954] that we use in this work is more general.\\\\n5. 这个问题的原因/动机（为什么会出现这个问题）、数学定义、输入输出和状态关系是什么？\\\\n- 哪些条件决定实现是否合法，哪些只是现有方案的选择？\\\\n- 算法具体怎样工作，数据怎样流动，状态怎样变化？\\\\n- 计算、访存、通信、准备、同步和驻留分别付出什么成本？\\\\n- 条件变化后，为什么应保留、调整或放弃这个方案？\\\\n- 怎样通过实现和实验区分竞争解释？\\\\n\\\\n这些是相关知识链的质量标准，不是每份文件必须照抄的六个标题。前置知识可以链接，但本章承担的核心算法、推导与边界不能用链接或名词清单代替。数学定义与真实硬件限制可以确定；某个引擎采用的分层、布局、算法和优化顺序应作为带前提的选择解释。\\\\n\\\\n## 正文与算法\\\\n\\\\n正文以问题和机制展开：说明问题为什么出现，定义对象和合法性，展开算法、数据流与状态更新，推导成本与组合关系，用设定算例、反例和区分实验解释结论如何改变。篇幅与结构由内容决定，不规定候选数、反例数或统一段落数量。\\\\n\\\\n实现逻辑可以转写为完整的算法伪代码，使用 pseudocode 标记的代码块。伪代码应给出输入输出、初始化、循环/分支、更新顺序和完成条件；正文说明正确性不变量、特殊输入与成本。调用一个未解释的库函数不能代替算法。现成 kernel、项目类结构、注册器、兼容分支和可执行命令保留在工程中。\\\\n\\\\n公式须说明符号、单位、轴和假设。区分逻辑数据量、实际设备事务量、容量峰值和关键路径时间；重叠工作不能把全部耗时直接相加。模型结构、数值策略、硬件能力或运行规模改变后，重新检查依赖与成本。\\\\n\\\\n## 来源阅读链\\\\n\\\\n论文保留直接可读的原始 PDF、必要图片和出处；来源说明用自己的话展开算法、推导、论文结论及其条件，明确哪些是论文报告、哪些是本库计算。文档同样保留原文，提炼定义、语义、约束及其设计含义。\\\\n\\\\n源码可以供知识编写者核对机制。交给 Agent 的内容应是经过核对的算法伪代码、数据流、状态关系与条件化事实，不能把整个实现文件称作知识原文。文档/源码混合资料按实际内容选择可读文档；文件扩展名、压缩包形式和仓库名称本身不决定知识价值。已有源码归档可以保留供溯源审计，其字节和哈希不因来源说明修订而改变。\\\\n\\\\n正文引用需要带实质内容，再指向来源说明；来源说明指向可读论文或文档。必要内容离线可读，不依赖 Agent 联网补全。准确版本留作证据身份；只有影响本题合法性或成本的版本事实进入论证，不搬运与本题无关的参数和分支。\\\\n\\\\n## 逐层阅读\\\\n\\\\n阅读入口按主题地图、章节摘要与问题/前提、二级节结构、完整论证、来源原文展开。Agent 自主选择阅读深度；索引与检索结果提供相邻机制，不产生必读清单。读取按实际字符范围与冻结修订记录；读过摘要不等于读过整章。\\\\n\\\\n## Base、观测和 workflow\\\\n\\\\nBase 的来源事实受发布版本的时间上限约束；编辑日期不改变事实日期。新的整理和独立推导保留真实日期与依据，后续实验不能伪装成历史 seed。\\\\n\\\\n运行观测保存环境、workload、测量方法、数值/单位/不确定性、实验证据与真实日期。机制知识解释因果、条件、预测和反例。Workflow 保存一类局部设计、诊断或验证问题的触发条件、前提、步骤、检查与退出/调整条件、成本和复用边界。三者相互引用，不能用一次成功代替机制解释或跨条件验证。\\\\n\\\\nEvolution 提炼、Diagnostician 独立复核，沿已有发布和证据机制进入后续冻结、检索与读取。Workflow 为可选方法，不自动成为 Controller 的全局顺序。跨任务资格使用现有权威晋升机制，负面与不确定结果保留，不建立平行资格体系。\\\\n\\\\n## 修订、覆盖和验证\\\\n\\\\n已有技术对象优先深化原章；独立对象才新增章节。修订保存登记前正文与元数据的准确字节，更新 catalog、来源说明哈希、导航、时间审计、VERSION 与变更清单。已存在的来源归档保持原身份。\\\\n\\\\n覆盖审计同时检查能力域、具体算法与跨机制组合，区分完整解释、仅提及、缺少推导、缺少证据和缺失；篇数和术语命中不是覆盖证明。结构/身份检查、独立算法算例、运行时读取/发布测试与真实构建效果分别报告。通过前几项不能声称已证明知识改善了 Agent 的系统设计或性能。\\\\n\\\\n六项标准的具体追问、组合案例、来源核对和使用效果边界见[知识内容审查](knowledge-review.md)。[Attention 模块](attention-module.md)是内容深度的已完成样例；其算法、硬件映射与组合状态按主题选择展开，不规定所有专题复制同样的结构。逐篇扩展状态见[扩展状态](expansion-status.json)，导航登记不代表深度验收完成。\\\\n\\\\n连续构建按[知识库构建 \\\"full\\\", \\\"category\\\": \\\"required\\\", \\\"content\\\": \\\"# 知识内容审查：从 Attention 样例推广\\\\n\\\\n本页把 Attention 多轮审查发现的问题整理为内容作者与审阅者可复用的问题。依据是[知识库构建方法](knowledge-method.md)中的六项标准，深度样例是[当前 Attention 模块](attention-module.md)。它不增加 Agent 的角色义务，也不要求每章采用同一结构、同样多的算例或统一的工程路线。\\\\n\\\\n## 知识库承担什么任务\\\\n\\\\n本库支持 InfraAgents 根据模型、workload、硬件和服务目标，从空工程构建、检验与持续优化完整推理系统。知识应提供五种帮助：还原问题的理论基础；区分合法条件与可探索的设计空间；给出足以独立实现的算法与状态关系；支持成本预测、实验和诊断；保存能够被反驳、修正和迁移的经验。\\\\n\\\\n一条有用的阅读链应支持读者形成这样的推理：任务与输入条件 → 正确性要求 → 候选算法与数据流 → 成本预测 → 区分实验 → 实现结果 → 修正后的结论。某一章可以承担其中一部分，但承担核心算法的地方不能只列注意事项或把关键步骤交给源码。\\\\n\\\\n## 六项标准怎样落实到实际问题\\\\n\\\\n| 内容标准 | 审阅时实际追问 | 过去发现的问题及其含义 |\\\\n|---|---|---|\\\\n| 原因、数学定义、输入输出和状态 | 为什么需要这个机制？每个量的轴、单位、范围和身份是什么？状态代表已知、已算、已确认还是已分配？ | FP8 只写“使用块尺度”不足以恢复分数和 PV 的共同单位；调度中的 token 已生成不等于其 KV 已计算 |\\\\n| 合法性与方案选择 | 哪条性质来自函数、数值契约或设备语义，哪条来自某个方案？等价性在实数、浮点还是特定误差范围内成立？ | 精确算术的归约结合性不能直接变成浮点逐位相同；图地址稳定不证明数据身份仍正确；内部 fragment 未公开就不能猜 lane 映射 |\\\\n| 算法、数据流和状态变化 | 能否写出初始化、推进、提交和结束？第一块、最后一块、空输入和失败分支怎样处理？每个被消费的量从哪里产生？ | 量化流程需要量化与恢复尺度；缓冲需要生产者、所有消费者及代次；硬件专题需要一条从逻辑 tile 到地址、线程、片上布局、指令输入和写回的完整路径 |\\\\n| 六类成本 | 是否在同一候选、相同输入和相同时间范围中列账？哪些量可以相加，哪些受关键路径和共享资源限制？ | 唯一 KV、各 head 请求流量和 DRAM 事务不能混算；共享容量只计一次；预留池与其中存活对象不能重复相加；深流水的驻留和 spill 会改变本来用于估时的吞吐 |\\\\n| 条件变化后的选择 | 改变 shape、状态组织、精度、到达轨迹或设备能力，哪条依赖保留，哪项成本改变？何种结果足以推翻原选择？ | 更多分区在并行度不足时有利，在已经饱和时可能只增加合并；更多缓冲不保证更快；缓存命中不保证新请求可立即执行 |\\\\n| 区分竞争解释 | 观察支持哪些解释？它们对某个可控改变给出什么不同预测？实验结果不符后怎样修改判断？ | “三级比两级慢”同时允许首尾、spill、驻留和未重叠解释；一次时间测量不能决定原因；软件事件模型不能证明 GPU 的内存可见性 |\\\\n\\\\n这些问题由主题决定使用范围。调度章节需要把就绪性、预算和输出归属连起来；缓存章节需要贯通身份、复制、发布和回收；硬件章节需要贯通布局、执行契约和资源。协议、统计或模型语义章节不必凭空增加矩阵指令实例。\\\\n\\\\n## 从单个机制走到组合案例\\\\n\\\\n分开解释各个机制之后，选择会改变合法性或成本的真实交界，追踪一次完整变化。例如共享前缀和私有尾块在追加、封存、发布、消费与回收期间，内容、scale、页表和读者必须属于一致的状态；调度器选中的工作必须已有上游输入和容量，而执行视图的压紧不能改变请求归属。\\\\n\\\\n审阅者沿一次轨迹检查：发生了什么输入事件；哪些对象仍存活；谁能写；谁已经取得读取权；何时对消费者可见；失败后哪些旧状态仍有效；取消后哪些工作仍在途；何时能把同一物理资源交给下一使用者。对象需要身份或代次时，解释防止的具体错误。只有单次同步执行的算法不必引入多代次协议。\\\\n\\\\n交界还包括“看似已经完成，下一步却没有输入”的状态。本轮调度审阅发现：完整命中 KV 而没有末行 logits 时，只按已知长度减 KV 长度选择工作会得到零，无法生成第一个新 token。修订明确了安全重算最后一个已知 token 的路径及共享写区隔离。沿状态图检查是否存在有合法请求却无后继事件的停滞，比只检查各状态的字段范围更有用。\\\\n\\\\n组合案例应使读者能计算至少一项会影响决定的代价，并解释另一种选择何时反转。重点是让独立机制能够正确拼接，不是枚举所有组合。示例的页长、tile、队列策略和版本字段均为可替换选择。\\\\n\\\\n## 阅读链与事实核对\\\\n\\\\n先检查正文承担的核心知识，再检查直接来源说明与足以支持关键事实的固定论文或文档。保留原始资料的错误、版本身份和字节，在解释中纠正公式或限定结论；自己的推导不能归为论文实测。源码可以用于作者核对，但读者独立实现所需的事实应进入允许读取的算法说明。\\\\n\\\\n审查记录写明读过哪些正文、哪些来源及其范围、发现的具体问题、实际修改与检查。只有读取摘要、术语检索或运行链接检查的专题，继续保留深度复核待完成状态。没有必要为了一个确定问题递归阅读所有引用。\\\\n\\\\n## 内容与使用效果分别验收\\\\n\\\\n内容审查判断六项标准在声明范围内是否有充分解释。作者侧算例验证代数、布局、边界、协议或成本模型；它需要独立参考、不变量或能触发错误的负对照，不能只让测试复述实现。读取测试检查冻结内容能否被取回及身份是否匹配。这三类证据各自有效，不能互相代替。\\\\n\\\\n直接使用检验让 Agent 在没有现成实现的情况下处理正文未直接演示的问题：重新推导合法算法，改变输入或硬件条件后重算，面对错误提出竞争解释，收到反证后修改方案。保存允许资料、任务、模型/上下文、预算、答卷或实现、执行结果及失败归因。交叉审阅兼做推导练习可以发现内容缺口，但有共同上下文、作者经验或未隔离的环境时，只能声称完成这次练习。\\\\n\\\\n如果要声称“知识改善了 Agent 的构建能力”，还需可比的知识版本或对照条件、多个代表任务以及预先说明的判断方法。目标 GPU 的数值、同步、重叠和性能仍需设备结果。没有最佳 tile 或流水级数不构成知识缺陷；没有解释如何推导候选、识别限制、测量与修正，才是内容缺口。\\\\n\\\\n## 怎样给出审查结论\\\\n\\\\n对每个问题给出正文位置、明确结论与证据边界，区分“已完整解释”“仅提及”“缺推导”“缺证据”“缺失”。这些描述可按实际内容组合使用，不转成总分或用测试数量抵消关键算法缺口。\\\\n\\\\n已经修复的问题在新修订中复核后关闭，不沿用旧审查中“仍缺 FP8/硬件映射/组合案例”的判断。新的缺口必须来自当前字节。Attention 当前的两个具体案例已补足内容展开，实际 Agent 独立构建与目标 GPU 效果仍有各自的验证边界。以当前内容和当前证据决定结论，不为了持续审查而不断增加验收条件。\\\\n\\\\n扩展工作优先完成相关专题的一条知识链，再复核跨专题衔接。当前批次与逐篇状态见[扩展状态](expansion-status.json)；历史审查保留当时结论，不覆盖成当前状态。\\\\n\\\", K-SYS-010：系统设计推导：把模型、缓存、执行与目标组合起来\\\\n\\\\n专家指导的产物是一条从任务条件到系统结构的推导链：状态模型、资源模型、候选设计及其可区分的结果。\\\\n\\\\n## 统一问题表述\\\\n\\\\n输入条件包括模型函数与状态、硬件资源、到达与长度分布、质量和时延目标。设计变量包括状态布局、调度粒度、执行后端、并行策略和阶段划分。输出应解释为什么这些变量组合在当前条件下有价值，以及改变哪个条件会促使设计改变。\\\\n\\\\n可以用四类关系串联：模型决定可复用状态；状态和 workload 决定容量与流量；硬件和 backend 决定执行成本；调度与队列决定用户看到的延迟。只优化其中一环可能把瓶颈推向另一环，设计需要顺着完整链重新求解。\\\\n\\\\n## 场景一：长系统提示、高前缀复用的 GQA 聊天服务\\\\n\\\\n先从 Hkv 计算 KV/token，再用长度分布得到驻留需求。大量相同系统前缀满足计算等价条件，适合共享前缀状态。分页让共享完整块与各请求私有尾部共存。前缀命中减少 prefill 工作，剩余新输入仍可分块，避免阻塞活跃 decode。\\\\n\\\\n当命中后 query 很短，主机调度、采样和 launch 的比例可能上升，因此固定缓冲的图执行与异步准备值得评估。图前缀页表在每轮内容变化，稳定地址与代次隔离一起设计。若加入多 LoRA，缓存身份与图形状还要包含 adapter 依赖；共享收益可能下降，应重新估算容量和路由。\\\\n\\\\n本设计的预测是 prefill 计算量按命中 token 减少，KV 物理驻留按实际共享页减少，单 token decode attention 仍读取其可见历史。若观测只有 hit rate 上升而队列更长，可能是亲和路由集中负载，应比较排队增加和计算节省。\\\\n\\\\n## 场景二：语音 Encoder-decoder 多请求服务\\\\n\\\\n源音频先经过明确的 processor 与 encoder，固定源可缓存各层 cross KV。decoder self KV 随目标长度增长，cross KV 由源长度决定，两个容量预算分开。encoder 批次按音频长度聚合，decoder 按迭代连续推进，阶段间传递带身份的源状态。\\\\n\\\\n若要流式输入，先判断 encoder 是否保证已提交表示稳定。双向 encoder 不具备该性质时，任意追加源并重用旧 cross KV 会改变函数。可选按模型支持的块协议接入，或将独立窗口识别作为另一种明确任务。首个稳定文本时延需包括输入窗口等待，不能只测 decode。\\\\n\\\\n## 场景三：MLA＋MoE 的多卡长上下文服务\\\\n\\\\nMLA 减少持久 attention 状态，但是否避免历史展开决定实际带宽收益；MoE 全部专家权重仍需驻留或按策略移动。容量账必须分别计 latent、专家、临时分组激活与通信区。EP 改变专家归属，TP 改变 attention/线性层分片，两者通信频率和消息分布不同。\\\\n\\\\n节点内外链路不同，先给高频同步选择强互联组，再计算远端 dispatch 的路径和偏斜。若 prefill/decode 分离，还要计 latent 状态在不同分片之间的传输与转换。较小 KV 不等于网络完全无代价；也不意味着专家热点被解决。\\\\n\\\\n## 场景四：静态编译平台上的混合长度任务\\\\n\\\\n模型函数固定，服务形状变化。按 prompt、query、context 和 batch 的联合分布选择有限桶，设备保留 KV，控制面只推进真实长度。短高频请求应有合适的小桶；稀少长请求可以用较粗桶，避免过多 executable 与 workspace 驻留。\\\\n\\\\n前缀命中会改变待算 query 分布，连续批会改变 batch 分布，投机会改变验证长度分布。桶选择因此应在这些机制组合后的 workload 上推导。若先按无缓存独立请求选桶，再加入其他机制，原配置可能失去意义。\\\\n\\\\n## 从推导到 RSI 增量\\\\n\\\\n规划说明当前链条中哪个关系最不确定，执行实现对应机制，诊断对其预测和实际状态进行核对。进化把新认识写回受影响的机制章节：补足成本项、修正可恢复条件或新增组合分支。成功不必产生新条目；更精确地理解一个现有机制，往往比增加一个孤立提示更有价值。\\\\n\\\\n## 候选空间、依赖和反证\\\\n\\\\n把设计变量按其影响对象组织：模型接入决定合法算子与状态；表示/布局决定容量与可用内核；执行调度决定同时存活对象；部署与路由决定访问路径；质量与 SLO 决定可接受结果。优化之间的依赖和冲突必须进入候选描述，例如图重放需要稳定缓冲、异步双缓冲增加在途容量、低位表示需要相容内核、跨实例复用需要一致版本与迁移语义。\\\\n\\\\n当候选的表示和资源假设已经明确时，容量与资源下界可以排除在这些假设下不可行的组合；未知项也可以通过原型或实验取得。一次性成本、稳态工作和失败恢复分别影响比较，不能只用最顺利的一次执行代表全部条件。一个优化被拒绝时，带宽提高、复用距离缩短或质量门槛改变可能使选择反转；改变表示或执行组织的新方案也可能不再受原模型约束。\\\\n\\\\n## 场景五：CPU 多请求生成的完整推导\\\\n\\\\n以下全部参数为可复算设定，不是项目机器或模型的实测结果。任务是固定版本的稠密 GQA decoder 文本生成，质量以独立固定前缀 forward 和任务评估为准；8 个活跃交互请求，平均外部到达 2 请求/s，每请求生成 64 token，输入平均 512 token，缓存计算历史上限 2048。目标客户端 ITL 为 60 ms；主机与响应预算暂设 4 ms，实际网络与排队是否满足此预算仍需测量。\\\\n\\\\n硬件设定为一个 32 核、32 GiB 可用主存的服务域，主存有效读带宽假设为 96 GiB/s；权重和已选布局合计驻留 3 GiB，固定与临时工作区预算 2 GiB。模型状态参数设为 24 层、4 个 KV head、每 head 128 维、每元素 2 字节。算子 dtype、累加和指令路径仍由具体实现确认，不能由权重大小推断。\\\\n\\\\n### 模型与容量\\\\n\\\\n每 token 全层 KV 为 2×24×4×128×2=49,152 字节，即 48 KiB。2048 token 历史为每请求 96 MiB；8 个请求为 768 MiB，权重+工作区+KV 合计 5.75 GiB，另需页尾、输入/输出队列和在途增量余量。64 个同长请求的该项合计为 11 GiB，仍低于 32 GiB；这只证明所列驻留项未超容量。\\\\n\\\\n加载先按 [制品与布局](../frameworks/checkpoint-loading.md) 建立固定参数，避免保留不必要的完整转换副本。请求状态由 [分配器](memory-allocators.md) 管理，初版不要求前缀共享，也不要求使用分页；连续池与固定块池可以保持同一模型语义，先比较长短混合时的碎片和增长方式。已输出 token 与已计算 KV 的边界按模型章节分别记录。\\\\n\\\\n### 三个执行候选\\\\n\\\\n| 候选 | 每次推进的组织 | 主要收益与代价 |\\\\n|---|---|---|\\\\n| A：逐请求单独执行 | 每次一个请求推进一个 token，再轮转 | 路径简单，但权重在多个请求间重复读取 |\\\\n| B：单实例连续批 | 同轮合并 8 个就绪 decode，prefill 受时间预算约束 | 摊薄权重读取，需要批次身份、状态与公平调度 |\\\\n| C：同域两个副本 | 两个实例各处理 4 个 decode，请求相互隔离 | 复制权重和工作区，竞争同一内存带宽 |\\\\n\\\\n在“每次调用读取全部 3 GiB 权重、每请求读取其全历史 KV、忽略其他流量”的设定下，A 一次的流量为 3.09375 GiB，带宽下界约 32.23 ms；8 个请求轮转一次约 257.81 ms，已经无法支持每个请求 60 ms 的间隔。B 一轮流量为 3.75 GiB，下界约 39.06 ms，对应这一资源模型下的吞吐上界约 204.8 输出 token/s。\\\\n\\\\nC 若把该内存域带宽平均分成每实例 48 GiB/s，每实例流量为 3.375 GiB，下界约 70.31 ms，仍超过目标。这个结论依赖共享同一带宽域的设定；若两个副本分别拥有独立内存控制器带宽，或权重常驻足够大的 cache，就必须重新计算，而不能照用此结论。\\\\n\\\\n64 个活跃请求若全部进入一轮，权重加 KV 流量为 9 GiB，带宽下界为 93.75 ms；可见“内存容得下 64 请求”与“64 请求都满足 ITL”不同。将 64 请求轮转成多个小批也不能消除它们等待其他轮次的时间。因此 admission 不能仅按内存上限设置。\\\\n\\\\n### 将 prefill、主机和质量接入同一方案\\\\n\\\\n对 B，60−4−39.06≈16.94 ms 是在当前理想 decode 下界之外剩余的预算，并不保证真实实现还有这么多。计算、额外流量和同步可能先消耗它。需要测量混合批的时间曲面，再按 [分块 prefill](../algorithms/chunked-prefill.md) 选择合法块；若所有块都不满足，应调整运行点、准入或资源，不能宣称增大 batch 已解决服务目标。\\\\n\\\\n平均到达产生 128 输出 token/s，低于 B 的上述理想上界，但还要支付每秒 1024 个新输入 token 的 prefill 和其他开销，所以仍不能据此断言系统稳定。主机侧给分词、调度和响应留独立预算，限制待处理 token 与输出字节；慢客户端与取消通过明确身份回传到调度和资源回收。\\\\n\\\\nCPU 线性层比较无打包/预打包、合适线程数和不同 M 形态。若考虑低位权重，再加“固定量化参数下的执行正确性”和“相对原模型质量”两层验证；新的字节下降应重新进入资源模型，不能把原有性能估计直接乘以理论压缩倍数。\\\\n\\\\n### 区分实验与反转条件\\\\n\\\\n先验证单请求固定前缀、完整/分块/增量 forward，再比较不同 batch 排列、不同槽位、跨页和取消后复用。小型可穷举状态轨迹检查同一逻辑请求不受物理布局影响；长运行检查空闲、活跃、共享与在途资源守恒。采用独立采样参考和协议事件验证输出，不只检查最终字符串。\\\\n\\\\n性能实验分别扫描活跃请求数、历史长度、prefill 块、算子线程和副本数，测实际权重/状态流量、CPU 阶段服务时间、TTFT/ITL、拒绝与队列增长。用 [统计方法](../tools/statistical-experiments.md) 在独立区组确认候选，保留首次加载和稳定态两种口径。\\\\n\\\\n若低负载仅有一个请求，A 的简单路径可能更合适；若独立 NUMA 域容量和带宽足够，C 的隔离价值可能超过权重复制代价；若长历史主导流量，继续增加 batch 的收益会下降；若任务转为离线且放宽 ITL，可以选择更大批和更粗 prefill。该场景给出的结论是条件化设计与待测量项，不是未经执行的性能承诺。\\\\n\\\\n## 十二类完整场景如何连成知识体系\\\\n\\\\n设计场景将各章的机制放进共同任务边界。下面的入口均包含声明条件下的候选与资源推导；它们给出可检验的设计，不表示已经在目标硬件完成性能实验。读取时先固定任务函数、质量与服务边界，再选择相应路径。\\\\n\\\\n| 任务形态 | 完整场景入口 | 需要一起检验的关系 |\\\\n|---|---|---|\\\\n| C01 CPU 多请求生成 | 本章 CPU 场景 | 权重/KV 流量、线程与 prefill 时间片、开放到达和 ITL |\\\\n| C02 单 GPU 交互 | [CUDA 平台](../hardware/cuda-execution.md) | 容量、带宽、内核/主机间隙、准入与实际输出 |\\\\n| C03 长上下文高复用 | [前缀缓存](../algorithms/prefix-cache-identity.md) | 物理共享容量、逻辑读取流量、路由与长尾 |\\\\n| C04 显存不足与三级存储 | [多级驻留](../algorithms/tiered-residency.md) | 有效副本、预取、共享带宽、双缓冲与恢复 |\\\\n| C05 CPU–GPU 混合执行 | [异构计算](../algorithms/heterogeneous-execution.md) | 计算放置、完整传输路径、结果合并和主机竞争 |\\\\n| C06 多卡 MLA/MoE | [多设备并行](../algorithms/parallelism.md) | 逐 rank 容量、head/latent/专家归属、通信与偏斜 |\\\\n| C07 P/D 与远端 KV | [分离服务](../algorithms/disaggregated-serving.md) | 首内容、第二 token、迁移提交和池配比 |\\\\n| C08 多模型/LoRA | [多模型放置](../workloads/multi-model-placement.md) | 共同基座、adapter/KV 预算、冷加载与租户等待 |\\\\n| C09 流式语音 | [转写](../models/encoder-decoder-streaming.md)、[语音生成](../models/speech-generation.md) | 稳定文字、可播放音频、各阶段状态与消费时钟 |\\\\n| C10 VLM/全模态 | [视觉语言](../models/vision-language.md)、[全模态](../models/omni-multimodal.md) | 媒体处理、特征/前缀缓存、分支同步与打断 |\\\\n| C11 图像视频扩散 | [图像扩散](../models/image-diffusion.md)、[视频生成](../models/video-generation.md) | 求解器、CFG、时空切分、VAE 与最终媒体质量 |\\\\n| C12 非生成推理 | [embedding/重排](../models/embedding-reranking.md)、[检索/RAG](retrieval-pipeline.md)、[视觉识别](../models/vision-inference.md)、[推荐](../models/recommendation-inference.md)、[GNN](../models/graph-inference.md) | 各自的输入函数、状态与任务指标；五种契约分别验证 |\\\\n\\\\n这些场景也会交叉：RAG 可以调用 embedding、检索、重排和生成；多模态服务可以同时需要多模型放置与低延迟音频。组合时必须重新计算共同资源与状态，不能把单场景的独占带宽或独立质量结果直接相加。\\\\n\\\\n## 实例方案要能落到服务和平台\\\\n\\\\n任务涉及多节点服务时，[集群放置](../workloads/cluster-resource-placement.md) 的拓扑和故障余量可能影响执行组；使用共享制品、缓存或提交记录时，[存储服务](storage-services.md) 的相应语义进入设计。它们是否存在、由候选实现还是由环境提供，取决于任务与所选方案；单机或离线引擎不因此自动获得这些功能要求。[部署环境](deployment-environment.md) 帮助解释实际配额、设备和版本；进程存活、文件存在或集群空闲卡数只提供各自范围内的信息。\\\\n\\\\n这些示例通过任务条件、状态、计算/流量/容量、交互语义与观察之间的关系解释方案。不同设计可以使用其他表示和推导组织；没有状态恢复或请求排队的任务不需要补造相应模块。结论取决于实际前提和证据，已有优化可以按需求采用、重组或省略。\\\\n\\\\n## 设计例子的适用范围与未列路径\\\\n\\\\n上述场景演示特定条件下的推导，不穷尽引擎架构或设计变量。Task 决定需要交付的函数、质量、性能和资源边界；一个例子中的调度器、状态池、阶段或验证顺序不会自动成为其他任务的要求。独立调度、整体编译、持久执行或其他组织方式，应按其实际前提和结果判断。\\\\n\\\\n机制的因果依赖与研发顺序不同。执行中消费者需要有效输入，不等于工程上必须先冻结全部接口再实现；一个成本假设可以通过独立实验先行检查，再与模型函数和状态设计共同修正。接口、表示、融合边界与调度可以联合演化，验证结论保留其实际覆盖范围，最终交付再依任务本身验收。\\\\n\\\\n本章列出的候选可以被扩展、组合或全部放弃。某个新方案没有现成章节或来源实现，并不使它失格；其假设可以在任务允许的工具和资源下受检验。阅读、引用或符合示例步骤本身不构成方案正确或更优的证据。\\\\n\\\\n## 布局改变后的完整成本与反转条件\\\\n\\\\n以下是设定的成本反例，不是设备实测。原路径在输入已满足布局的条件下计算 1.0 ms。新 kernel 计算为 0.6 ms，但需要一次 0.5 ms 的输入转换；若两者有依赖且无可隐藏区间，一次执行为 1.1 ms。若同一合法转换结果可以复用 R 次，新路径总成本为 0.5+0.6R ms，原路径为 R ms；严格获益要求 R>1.25，R=2 时为 1.7 ms 对 2.0 ms。\\\\n\\\\n这个反例不要求保留转换边界。让上游直接产生目标布局、融合转换与计算、换用别的状态表示，都会改变模型中的成本项。若输入每次改变，复用前提则不成立；若转换争用另一消费者的带宽，也需重新计算。公式用于判断已声明候选，不能据它排除改变公式前提的新设计。\\\\n\\\\n<!-- infraagents:provenance -->\\\\n\\\\n## 来源与推导\\\\n\\\\n- [S-PAGED：Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention](../sources/S-PAGED.md)：PagedAttention 把每条序列的逻辑 KV 划分为固定 token 数的块，用映射表访问不连续物理存储。多个序列可以共享相同前缀的物理块，分叉写入需要保持各序列状态独立。\\\\n  [完整原文](../../references/S-PAGED/reader.html) · [全文文本](../../references/S-PAGED/fulltext.txt)\\\\n\\\\n- [S-SARATHI：SARATHI: Efficient LLM Inference by Piggybacking Decodes with Chunked Prefills](../sources/S-SARATHI.md)：SARATHI 将长 prefill 切块，并在合适的批处理中与 decode 组织在一起，以减少两类工作之间的干扰并利用计算资源。\\\\n  [完整原文](../../references/S-SARATHI/reader.html) · [全文文本](../../references/S-SARATHI/fulltext.txt)\\\\n\\\\n- [S-DISTSERVE：DistServe](../sources/S-DISTSERVE.md)：DistServe 将 prefill 与 decode \\\"reading_scope\\\": \\\"full\\\", \\\"category\\\": \\\"source_note\\\", \\\"content\\\": \\\"# S-PAGED：Efficient Memory Management for Large Language Model Serving with PagedAttention\\\\n\\\\n## 原文\\\\n\\\\n[原始 PDF](../../references/S-PAGED/original.pdf) · [完整原文](../../references/S-PAGED/reader.html) · [全文文本](../../references/S-PAGED/fulltext.txt)\\\\n\\\\n固定版本：2309.06180v1。来源版本日期：2023-09-12；整理核对日期：2026-10-28。可直接阅读全文；下面是本库核对后抽出的机制与结论。\\\\n\\\\n## 问题\\\\n\\\\n当时的服务系统为每条请求按最大长度预留连续 KV 空间。论文测得只有 20.4%–38.2% 的 KV 内存存放了真实 token 状态，其余是为未来 token 保留的槽、超额预留造成的内部碎片，以及分配器的外部碎片。这限制了批大小，进而限制吞吐。\\\\n\\\\n## 机制\\\\n\\\\n块化 attention（§4.1）。把每条序列的 KV 切成固定 token 数 B 的块，Kⱼ = (k₍ⱼ₋₁₎B₊₁ … k_{jB})，Vⱼ 同理。对 query i，块 j 内位置 t 的权重仍是 exp(qᵢᵀkₜ/√d) 除以所有合法 key 的指数和；分母跨全部有效块，不能分别归一化每块再直接相加。输出是所有块内权重乘 V 的和。kernel 逐块取址，块在物理上可以不连续。各层各 head 的 K/V 可以放在同一块里，也可以各用独立块与独立块表；论文在其实现背景下称两种设计性能无差别，不能据此证明任意设备的两种布局同速。\\\\n\\\\n块表（§4.2）。每条请求有逻辑块到物理块的映射，每项记录物理块号与已填充位置数。逻辑块从左到右填满后才分配下一个物理块，因此每条请求的浪费被限制在最后一块以内。GPU 上由一个 block engine 预分配一大段显存再切成物理块；CPU 内存也按同样方式管理以支持换出。\\\\n\\\\n共享与写时复制（§4.4）。同一物理块可被多个逻辑块映射，每个物理块维护引用计数；某个序列要写入引用计数大于 1 的块时，先分配新块、复制内容、把原块计数减一，再写新块。并行采样、beam search 与共享系统提示都靠这一机制共享前缀 KV。论文用逻辑引用计数表述释放；若具体执行允许设备工作异步在途，则还需独立证明最后物理读者已结束，不能把论文的逻辑计数直接当成完整异步回收协议。\\\\n\\\\n抢占的两条路（§4.5）。换出：把被抢占序列的块复制到 CPU 内存，恢复时再搬回；CPU 侧换出空间不超过 GPU 物理块总数。重算：丢弃状态，恢复时把已生成 token 与原 prompt 拼接一次性重新 prefill。\\\\n\\\\n## 结论\\\\n\\\\n- 块大小的权衡（§7.2，Fig. 18b）：块越大，kernel 并行处理的位置越多、硬件利用率越高，但内部碎片越大。ShareGPT 轨迹上 16–128 都表现最好；Alpaca 轨迹（序列更短）上 16 和 32 好，更大的块明显变差。论文选 16。\\\\n- 块化 kernel 的额外开销（§7.1，Fig. 18a）：访问块表、额外分支与变长处理使 attention kernel 延迟比高度优化的连续实现高 20–26%；论文认为它只影响 attention 算子，可以接受。\\\\n- 端到端：相同延迟下吞吐比当时的系统高 2–4 倍，序列越长、模型越大、采样越复杂提升越明显。\\\\n\\\\n## 本库据此推导\\\\n\\\\n- \\\\\\\"逻辑位置顺序不变、物理放置任意\\\\\\\"是分页的不变量；块大小是粒度轴上的一个点，论文的 16 来自两条特定轨迹，不是常数，见 [分页 KV](../algorithms/paged-kv-capacity.md)。\\\\n- 引用计数管理逻辑所有者、完成事件管理物理使用者，二者都成立才能重用；论文只写了前者，后者由异步执行引入，见 [内存分配](../system-semantics/memory-allocators.md)。\\\\n- 20–26% 的 kernel 开销是\\\\\\\"间接寻址换容量\\\\\\\"这条交换的实测价格之一，见 [Attention 执行接口](../frameworks/attention-backends.md)。\\\\n- 换出与重算的比较由状态大小、链路带宽与重算长度决定，见 [连续批处理](../algorithms/iteration-batching.md) 与 [KV 卸载](../algorithms/kv-offload-prefetch.md)。\\\\n- [分页 KV 正文](../algorithms/paged-kv-capacity.md) 的 NHD/HND 字节映射、不可变快照追加与失败回滚、图读者票据和页长成本反转，是本库在 2026-10-28 根据上述机制构造的具体实例。论文不规定该布局、每次追加都 COW、图包数量或完成票据的数据结构。\\\\n\\\\n## 适用边界\\\\n\\\\n论文的数字针对 2023 年的 A100 与 OPT/LLaMA 模型。块化 attention 的开销比例随 kernel 实现变化，后来的实现可以降低它。版本日期不证明模型训练实际包含该资料。\\\\n\\\", 行，可利用矩阵计算；decode 每请求通常只有一行，读取权重的代价难以由单行摊薄。混合批的组成又会改变 pipeline 各阶段时长，使不同微批的时间不均衡。\\\\n\\\\n§4 的 chunked-prefills 把一个已知 prompt 切成多个块，后块继续读此前块的 KV。Figure 6 用逐步增长的 causal 大小下，长 prefill 可以提供多次混合机会。这个组合依赖有足够已就绪的 decode、合适的 chunk 与设备形态；prefill 不足时仍会出现 decode 尾部，额外 chunk 边界也会重复准备和执行成本。\\\\n\\\\n论文中的计算均匀性目标不等于每个固定 token 块严格等时。历史 h 增大后，q 行 Attention 的合法对数为 qh+q(q+1)/2；同一 q 可以在不同运行点支付不同读取、计算和 kernel 费用。不能把“chunk size”无条件当成时间片长度，或者把论文中的混合收益视为长历史 decode 的免费计算。\\\\n\\\\n## InfraAgents 如何据此推导\\\\n\\\\n[分块 采用同样的时间模型或取消协议。\\\\n\\\\n对一段相同 prompt，把各块的 qh+q(q+1)/2 相加，恰好等于整段的 causal 对数。切片降低单次不可抢占区间，通常会重复固定成本；只有加入并发请求和服务目标，才能判断这种交换是否值得。实验要同时比较已有 decode 的 ITL、新请求 TTFT、总服务时间、实际提供负载和拒绝，不能只引用混合 GEMM 的每 token NUMA、并发或工作集改变时，重新判断原配置是否适用\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\n本库据此分析算子内并行与请求级并发的预算、cache/TLB 工作集和跨 NUMA 流量，见[CPU 服务](../hardware/cpu-serving.md)及[主机运行时](../system-semantics/host-runtime.md)。教程中的配置示例是特定环境的候选，不是所有 CPU 就自动拥有的能力。若只是重放已确认输出，应从输出账恢复，不得重新采样。\\\\n\\\\n若末行产生 EOS，本例记录停止事件并结束请求，不要求为 EOS 再算 KV；协议是否把 EOS 作为可见内容由输出契约决定。本例另外规定 n 不超过给定总 token 上限 Nmax：n=Nmax 或已达生成数量上限时，完成当前必要计算后直接结束，不再产生新 token；若采样使生成数量刚达上限，保留该已确认输出并结束，不再计算它的 KV。空 prompt 需要事先约定 BOS 或拒绝，本例拒绝空输入；准入时拒绝 n>Nmax，输出上限为零的请求无需启动生成。投机、分支和多模态输入需要各自扩展确认规则，不能只放大本例 q 的上界。\\\\n\\\\n还需区分采样已确认与输出已交付。假设本例有带序号的可靠输出队列，gᵣ 是已确认的生成内容数，dᵣ≤gᵣ 是消费者已确认接收的个数。输出记录以请求生命期、生成序号去重；业务取消后停止新增交付。等待网络或消费者释放的结果缓冲仍占容量，不能因为 KV 已完成就覆写它。随机采样状态也按请求和逻辑位置关联；批次压紧不应改变哪条随机流属于哪个请求。\\\\n\\\\n## 选择、预留、提交和完成的完整算法\\\\n\\\\n输入是长期请求状态、模型与资源就绪事件、页池、输出队列以及一组可测量的本轮预算。输出是一份不可变执行视图及其完成后的状态变化。以下用独占可写尾页简化说明，共享前缀的身份和 COW 由[分页 KV](paged-kv-capacity.md)承担；预留函数返回的必须是已验证可写的页集合，不能只返回一个足够大的计数。\\\\n\\\\n协调器顺序处理到达、取消、提交和完成事件，设备按视图运行。排序是一个可替换的选择步骤；把排序、可执行性和容量承诺混在一个优先级分数里，无法保证合法。某个高优先级请求未就绪时，扫描其他候选而不让它占用本轮预算。对已知 q 范围，可用单调校准模型或枚举合法图桶求最大可行 q；模型非单调时不能擅用二分。\\\\n\\\\n```pseudocode\\\\n输入：请求账、已确认完成事件、可写页池、本轮 token/时间/输出缓冲预算\\\\n准入/恢复：校验非空输入和长度上限；按上述规则建立可生成的 KV 的物理写覆盖它。这个反例必须实际执行释放、重分配和旧写到达，检查新对象内容或“在途操作仍保护原租约”的独立不变量；只计算一个假想 free 向量不构成该负对照。\\\\n\\\\n## 状态包价值与条件化成本\\\\n\\\\n删除一个很小的递归检查点，可能让大量 KV 失去同位置继续执行的价值。设检查点 c 被状态包集合 Q(c) 依赖，删除后包 q 的额外重放步数为 Δ_q(c)，则可用\\\\n\\\\nL(c)＝Σ_{q∈Q(c)} λ_q Δ_q(c)\\\\n\\\\n估计损失；λ_q 将完整模型步折成时间或服务价值。它只能作为策略线索：共享物理对象、未来重用概率、公平性和 deadline 使多个淘汰选择相互影响。若删除后连合法重放起点都不存在，不能只给一个有限额外步数。\\\\n\\\\n以下容量均为结构设定。8 层全 attention、8 层窗口 attention、16 层递归层；attention 每层 Hkv＝8、d＝128、K/V 每元素 2 B，消费长度 4096、窗口保留 256 个位置。单层每 token 为 2×8×128×2＝4096 B。\\\\n\\\\n| 项目 | 算式 | 大小 |\\\\n|---|---:|---:|\\\\n| 全 attention | 8×4096×4096 B | 128 MiB |\\\\n| 窗口 attention | 8×256×4096 B | 8 MiB |\\\\n| 递归状态 | 16×4096×16×4 B | 4 MiB |\\\\n| 卷积历史 | 16×3×4096×2 B | 384 KiB |\\\\n| 主项 | 128＋8＋4＋0.375 | 140.375 MiB |\\\\n\\\\n窗口容量采用保留 W 个槽的组织；下一步最少读取 W−1 个旧位置与当前 token，不能把读取下界与物理分配槽数混为一谈。删去 4.375 MiB 的递归和卷积状态，可能让另外 136 MiB 的 attention 状态失去原位置直接恢复资格。\\\\n\\\\n若每 256 token 另存递归及卷积快照，16 份为 70 MiB。这里“另存”假设与当前工作状态不别名；若末端快照与当前不可变状态共享，应按实际唯一对象扣除重复项。设统一页为 512 KiB，每递归层连同卷积历史为 280 KiB，按层独占页时 16 层 padding 为 16×232 KiB＝3.625 MiB。多层打包会改变该账。\\\\n\\\\n六类成本应在同一恢复计划上列出：\\\\n\\\\n- 计算：T_replay(c,p)＝Σ_{t=c}^{p−1} C_step(t)，C_step 是完整模型步骤；目标 1024 从 768 重放需要 256 步，不能只计递归张量更新。检查点构造与格式转换也可能计算密集。\\\\n- 访存：状态读取、候选写入、检查点复制、COW 和块表访问。统一页分配字节不等于 kernel 实际读取字节，更不等于 DRAM 事务量。\\\\n- 通信：对每条共享链路 e，传输下界为 Σ_g B_{g,e}/β_e。独立链路可重叠，但总时间还受逐层依赖关键路径约束；不能只看最快到达的一族。\\\\n- 准备：身份核对、状态资格搜索、重放输入核对、页表与描述符、引用登记、子分配和 block/flat 转换。连续范围覆盖与检查点成员查询均为常数成本时，下降搜索中的状态族资格部分为 O(nF)，n 是候选位置上界，F 是必需族数；逐候选输入扫描的最坏 O(n²) 成本必须另计，不能把 O(nF) 当作完整规划成本。缺页结构另计范围查询成本，资源向量构造、保护与预留另按实际执行次数和处理对象计费。\\\\n- 同步：复制完成、层间依赖、步骤提交、最终发布以及失败排空。超时失败可能很快返回业务结果，但资源继续驻留。\\\\n- 驻留：唯一源对象、目标私有增量、检查点、padding、工作区、元数据和未排空对象的同时存活峰值。预留与其物化页不重复相加，共享页只计一次。\\\\n\\\\n输入扫描的上界来自实际循环。目标 p≤n，候选 c 的区间长为 p−c；即使检查遇到缺项立即短路，总输入位置查询数仍可能达到\\\\n\\\\nQ_input＝Σ_{c=0}^{p−1}(p−c)＝p(p＋1)/2。\\\\n\\\\n若一次查询用常数时间判断该位置的 token 和全部必需特征可重放，则资格搜索加输入扫描最坏为 O(nF＋n²)。这里的常数时间假设针对已经可查询的输入记录，不包括读取外部特征文件、校验大对象或等待数据到达。若每位置还需检查 A 个独立特征项且每项为常数成本，输入扫描可达 O(n²(1＋A))；一般应累计实际检查项的成本。基线扫描只需常数额外游标空间，不创建输入可用性前缀表，原有输入和状态目录的驻留另计。\\\\n\\\\n一个能达到二次查询量的失败轨迹是：目标 p＝n，全 KV 只保留 [0,n−1)，没有窗口、卷积或递归族限制，初始化可用；重放输入仅有位置 0…n−2，缺少最后的 x_{n−1}。目标 n 不能直接恢复，n−1…0 都是合法直接起点。\\\", \\\"excerpt_ranges\\\": [[8000, 10236]], \\\"range_unit\\\": \\\"zero-based half-open characters in extracted text\\\", \\\"extracted_characters\\\": 14022, \\\"related_chapter\\\", \\\"content\\\": \\\"[EXCERPT extracted-character range 0:2236]\\\\n# K-WORK-006：容量设计：驻留、服务率与阶段配比\\\\n\\\\n容量设计把每请求资源需求和阶段服务时间连接到到达过程，得出实例数、并发和缓存预算。\\\\n\\\\n## 先解驻留约束\\\\n\\\\n可用设备内存 M 扣除权重 W、固定工作区 F、峰值激活 A 和图池 G，剩余才可用于请求状态。普通 KV 请求 i 约占 cNᵢ，加上页尾碎片；共享前缀要按物理唯一页计，而不能把所有逻辑长度相加。递归/多模态状态按各族分别计。\\\\n\\\\n若剩余 16 GiB、每请求平均状态 512 MiB，理想平均最多 32 个；但长度尾部、峰值并发和分配粒度使这个平均估计不构成硬 admission 上限。可以按当前实际占用及下一步最坏增量预留，或用明示的概率模型管理风险。\\\\n\\\\n## 再解服务率约束\\\\n\\\\nprefill 需求近似为每秒到达×每请求未命中输入工作，decode 需求近似为每秒到达×平均输出步工作。两阶段成本依赖 batch 与历史，所以应通过少量代表形态建立服务曲面，而非一个固定 tokens/s 常量。\\\\n\\\\n分离池的实例数比例由两个需求除各自有效服务能力得出，再留出满足尾延迟的余量。平均利用率接近 100% 时，轻微波动就会堆积队列；目标 SLO 越紧，可接受利用率区间通常越受限制。\\\\n\\\\n## 网络和主机也是容量约束\\\\n\\\\n每请求需要迁移 K 字节时，平均传输需求 λK；与模型并行通信共用链路时还要合并流量。CPU tokenization 或媒体处理有独立服务率。扩 GPU 数而不扩这些阶段，可能只让设备等待。\\\\n\\\\n## 从估算到决策\\\\n\\\\n已知前提下的资源下界可以排除不可行配置；未知的有效算力、带宽和阶段时间可以通过原型或运行测量取得。解析估算与实验可交替修正，不要求下界筛选先于所有实验。若估算误差很大，优先解释缺失成本而不是堆更多参数搜索。更准确的成本模型本身就是 RSI 应写回知识库的高价值结果。\\\\n\\\\n## 从一个吞吐常数走向服务曲面\\\\n\\\\n在少量有解释的坐标上测服务能力：query token 数、历史长、batch、dtype、缓存命中、模型版本和并行组。对每点记录计算时间、主存/设备流量、工作区峰值和主机开销。需要插值时说明适用区域，遇到 kernel 切换、桶边界、重编译或跨 NUMA 放置应另建区段；不能把连续线性假设越过结构性变化。\\\\n\\\\n一个资源 j 的必要条件可写成 λ·E[dⱼ]≤nⱼ·cⱼ，其中 dⱼ 为每请求资源需求，nⱼ 为实例或资源份数，cⱼ 为相应能力。CPU 秒、设备计算秒、链路字节和存储 I/O 使用各自单位。这个平均约束只能排除明显不足的配置，尾延迟还依赖方差、排队、拓扑与相关性。\\\\n\\\\n## 阶段配比必须包括状态交换\\\\n\\\\n设定每秒 4 个请求，未命中输入平均 1000 token、输出平均 100 token；某已声明形态的每实例 prefill 能力假设为 2500 输入 token/s、decode 为 250 输出 token/s。平均需求分别为 4000 和 400 token/s，两个池都至少需要向上取整的 2 个实例。若每请求迁移 0.5 GiB 状态，网络需求又是 2 GiB/s；可用链路低于此值时，池的数量满足算式也不能保证可行。\\\\n\\\\n这个设定还没有证明 SLO，因为额外传输延迟、两个池的排队、实例负载不均和失败余量都未解决。CPU 预处理、模型加载与共享存储同样可能限制整体；新增 GPU 时重新计算所有约束，避免只扩已经不是瓶颈的阶段。\\\\n\\\\n## 冷启动、故障与弹性迟滞\\\\n\\\\n扩容时间包含资源分配、环境启动、制品读取、转换、编译与预热。若突发持续时间短于实例就绪时间，响应式扩容可能赶不上，需要预留热实例、提前预测或准入控制。热实例保留成本与冷启动等待可以比较，但必须使用目标 workload 的到达与模型切换分布。\\\\n\\\\n缩容先停止新准入，再排空或迁移在途请求，最后释放模型与状态。迁移会占用网络和目标容量；不能把发出迁移命令当作源端容量已经释放。故障容量还要按故障域计算：多个实例共用同一主机、NIC 或存储路径时，不能将它们视为独立冗余。\\\\n\\\\n## 校准与选择反转\\\\n\\\\n容量边界、各资源平均必要条件、到达轨迹与尾部目标分别检验驻留、持续供给、排队和故障恢复；根据当前问题选取相应证据，并在完整交付时满足 Task 的实际要求。模型偏差出现时，核对实际完成工作、重复流量、重算、加载、同步和在途资源，而不是只拟合一个更复杂的回归式。\\\\n\\\\n前缀命中提高会减少 prefill 需求，输出变长会增加 decode 和驻留需求；更快存储改变冷启动成本，但不一定改变常驻模型吞吐。把这些敏感性保留在设计记录中，才能解释为什么同一集群在 workload 改变后需要不同的 P/D、CPU、网络和存储配比。\\\\n\\\\n<!-- infraagents:provenance -->\\\\n\\\\n## 来源与推导\\\\n\\\\n- [S-PAGED：Efficient Memory Management 计一次，其安全复用仍受重放次序和不并发条件约束。\\\\n\\\\nallocator allocated 和 reserved 是观测口径，不能直接成为额外相加项。需要从同一 allocator 的快照识别其覆盖的活跃对象、完整池及剩余保留；allocated/reserved 的差也不一定能代表其他 allocator、驱动或全部图池。总峰值为 max_t Host(t)、max_t 池外转换区的显式主机主项为 1.5 GiB；仍需另计元数据、源缓存和额外保留。若加载器还保留 14 GiB 主机目标，则该主项变成 15.5 GiB。设备上的 14 GiB 权重另入设备账，这些数字均为设定量。\\\\n\\\\n固定块池的尾部浪费取决于组织。每张量单独分块需要 Σ_t ceil(w_t/b) 个槽位，跨张量打包可接近 ceil(Σ_t w_t/b)，但扩大一个块的消费者集合和失败范围。别名用途不重复计根；相同值的独立存储仍计两份。\\\\n\\\\n准备成本包括清单解析与排序、文件打开与元数据读取、池分配/锁页、离线格式转换、目标分配和执行器建立。按文件排序范围通常为 O(Σ_f T_f log T_f)，其中 T_f 是文件内范围数；转换、解包与哈希分别随实际元素数或读取字节增长。转置至少需要读取源并写入目标，低位解包可能把 W_q 字节源扩成 W_d 字节传输；校验、填充、过读、额外 staging 和缓存复制都增加实际流量。有效权重字节不能代替主存、SSD、NIC 与 PCIe 的各自事务量。\\\\n\\\\n对 N 个等大块，三个独立单服务阶段耗时为 t_r、t_c、t_d，缓冲足够且无额外依赖时，N≥1 的理想完成时间为\\\\n\\\\nT_N=t_r+t_c+t_d+(N−1)max(t_r,t_c,t_d)，T_0=0。\\\\n\\\\n更一般地，第 i 块第 k 阶段的完成时间可递推为 F_i,k=max(F_i−1,k,F_i,k−1)+t_i,k，边界为零；它已经包括首块依赖和尾部排空。两块、三阶段各耗时 1 的轨迹是：读 c0 在 [0,1)，转换 c0 与读 c1 在 [1,2)，传输 c0 与转换 c1 在 [2,3)，传输 c1 在 [3,4)，完成时间为 4。六个阶段工作的总耗时为 6，只有全部串行时才是完成时间。\\\\n\\\\n若 CPU 读取与转换共用一个串行 worker，或读与 H2D 争用主存/PCIe，必须加入对应资源边，不能继续采用独立阶段公式。各资源总需求除以其共享有效能力给出必要下界，真实时间还受依赖、提交、排队和不均匀尾块约束。更多缓冲只在能解除等待且预算允许时有益。\\\\n\\\\n多 rank 的 L_r 应是该 rank 从可开始加载到本地准备完成的实际依赖图完成时间，包含其流水、检查和编译/预热关系。在 rank 资源独立、排队 q_r 位于本地工作之前、共同 barrier 位于其后时，\\\\n\\\\nT_ready=max_r(q_r+L_r)+T_barrier。\\\\n\\\\n例如两个 rank 的两块流水均需 4，排队分别为 0 和 1，共同 barrier 假设为 0.5，则为 5.5。不能把每 rank 的读取、转换和传输总工作量直接相加替代 L_r。仅在这些阶段强制串行时，才可使用 read_total+transform_total+transfer_total；编译与预热也只有位于其后时才能直接再加。\\\\n\\\\n若加载中存在跨 rank 通信或共享 SSD、NIC、CPU、主存带宽，应把这些任务放进共同依赖与资源图求完成时间；已经计入图中的屏障不能再加一次。快 rank 完成不能补足慢 rank 的发布资格。等待、取消排空和旧版本驻留都是实际成本。\\\\n\\\\n## 条件变化后的选择\\\\n\\\\n模型常驻且只加载一次时，复杂流水、锁页池和直接 I/O 的准备成本可能难以摊销。频繁冷启动、模型切换或主存接近上限时，流式加载的容量优势和重叠收益可能改变可行性。准备成本、失败排空和驻留不能从生命周期比较中消失。\\\\n\\\\n源存储变快后，瓶颈可能移到 CPU 转置、解包或元数据处理；PCIe 受限时增加读取线程可能只增加主机驻留和队列。块太小增加索引、提交与检查开销，块太大延长首块等待并抬高峰值；不存在脱离硬件、布局和并发的通用最佳块大小。\\\\n\\\\nmmap 可复用只读文件页，热缓存可能减少存储读取；冷访问仍可能缺页并等待 I/O。直接 I/O 便于应用控制缓冲及缓存，但有具体对齐和路径要求，不自动等于异步，也不自动等于存储直接向 GPU DMA。锁页能支持稳定主机页上的异步传输，锁页分配和过量锁页本身有成本。\\\\n\\\\n离线转置、重分片和预打包把工作移到制品准备阶段，增加存储、分发字节及失效范围。目标 rank 数、量化格式、目标内核或编译器依赖改变后，应重新检查这些产物；运行时参数 ABI 和布局不变时，也不能无依据要求所有数值替换都重新编译。比较按实际复用次数摊销，低位源离线展\\\", \\\"excerpt\\\", \\\"category\\\": \\\"related_chapter\\\", \\\"content\\\": \\\"[EXCERPT extracted-character range 8000:10236]\\\\n处理，不能把此处的逐行位置推广到所有调用模式。\\\\n\\\\n每个向量的旋转主项为 R/2 对、每对四乘两加，即约 3R FLOP，另有三角值计算或查表。对 T 行、Hq 个 Q heads 与 Hkv 个 K heads，旋转算术主项为 3TR(Hq+Hkv)。相同位置的三角值可跨 heads 复用；完整表需要为覆盖的位置保存每对的 sin/cos。融合投影写出或 K-cache 写入可减少新增表示的中间读写，收益随 T 增长，不自动减少 attention 对合法历史的读取。频率、配对或旋转维变化时，旧 K-rot 不再自动兼容，须重建或放弃复用。\\\\n\\\\n## 激活、softmax 与可合并统计\\\\n\\\\n门控 FFN 可写为 U=XWᵤ，G=φ(XW𝗀)，输出 (G⊙U)W𝒹。两条上投影的通道对应、bias、门函数和参数顺序属于模型定义。SiLU(x)=x·sigmoid(x)；为避免指数溢出，x≥0 时可用 x/(1+exp(−x))，x<0 时用 x·exp(x)/(1+exp(x))。精确 GELU 与近似 GELU 是不同的数值函数。\\\\n\\\\n可重建的执行顺序是：两条完整上投影各自完成归约和 bias；对门分支逐元素应用 φ；按同一 token/FFN 通道相乘；下投影完整归约后应用自己的 epilogue。若上投影各为 M×F、中间元素 s 字节，分别物化 U、门结果及乘积会带来这些缓冲的写读；融合可让乘积直接成为下游输入，但仍须支付下游读取或合适的片上交接。更大的融合区域也可能增加驻留、spill 或限制矩阵内核。\\\\n\\\\n对有限可见 logits，softmax 定义为 pᵢ=exp(zᵢ−m)/Σⱼ∈A exp(zⱼ−m)，m=maxᵢ∈A zᵢ。不可见项不进入分子或分母。下面选择空行返回零概率、empty=true、自然对数 LSE=−∞；这是一项明确的示例契约。\\\\n\\\\n```pseudocode\\\\n算法 StableMaskedSoftmax\\\\n输入：z[N]、显式可见集合 A⊆{0,…,N−1}\\\\n输出：p[N]、empty、自然对数 LSE\\\\n1 检查 A 的索引有效；可见分数必须有限，否则拒绝或转特殊值路径\\\\n2 若 A 为空：返回全零 p、true、−∞\\\\n3 m=max_{i∈A} z[i]\\\\n4 l=Σ_{i∈A} exp(z[i]−m)\\\\n5 对 i=0,…,N−1：\\\\n6    若 i∈A：p[i]=exp(z[i]−m)/l\\\\n7    否则：p[i]=0\\\\n8 返回 p、false、m+ln(l)\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\nN=0 由空集合分支处理。全 mask 行用有限负常数填充后调用普通 softmax，会得到非零均匀分布；这改变了本章契约。可见输入含正无穷时出现 ∞−∞，也不能依靠减最大值修复。\\\\n\\\\n分块时，对已处理可见集合保存 m=max z、l=Σexp(z−m)、U=Σexp(z−m)v，v 可以是一个向量。空状态为 E=(−∞,0,零向量)。两个集合必须不重叠，并集恰好是需要的归约域。\\\\n\\\\n```pseudocode\\\\n算法 MergeSoftmaxStates\\\\n输入：同一单位、维度和指数底数下的两个状态 (m1,l1,U1)、(m2,l2,U2)\\\\n输出：合并状态\\\\n1 若 l1=0：返回第二个状态\\\\n2 若 l2=0：返回第一个状态\\\\n3 m=max(m1,m2)\\\\n4 r1=exp(m1−m)，r2=exp(m2−m)\\\\n5 l=r1·l1+r2·l2\\\\n6 对每个 value 通道 c：U[c]=r1·U1[c]+r2·U2[c]\\\\n7 返回 (m,l,U)\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\n空分支避免 −∞−(−∞)。新最大值改变尺度时，l 与 U 都要重标度；只修正分母会让输出错误。非空最终输出为 U/l，LSE=m+ln(l)。单独归一化各段再拼接概率会使质量和等于非空段数；直接平均各段 attention 输出也忽略各段质量。\\\\n\\\\n普通 softmax 是 O(N) 归约与指数工作，保存整行需要 O(N) 临时元素；重算指数或分段统计可改变临时驻留与读取次数。融合 attention 保留局部概率和统计，可避免完整分数/概率矩阵写回，其 IO 推导与条件见 [S-FLASH](../sources/S-FLASH.md) 和 [Attention IO](attention-io.md)。\\\\n\\\\n底数也是中间接口的一部分。使用 exp2 计算自然指数时，score 乘以 1/ln2；若保存 log₂Z，恢复自然对数 LSE 必须乘 ln2。固定 Triton 来源说明承载这一机制，不能把两类统计直接互换。\\\\n\\\\n输出 dtype 不能概括整条数值路径。[S-TORCH-NUMERIC 的固定文档](../sources/S-TORCH-NUMERIC.md)说明，所述 SDPA math 默认路径会把 FP16/BF16 输入提升到 FP32，执行 FP32/TF32 计算再转换输出，这同时改变误差和内存成本。此事实限定于该文档所述版本与路径；本章不据 S-SDPA 断言 functional.softmax 的 dtype 参数语义。一般比较仍需明确转换发生在输入、乘法、局部和、概率还是输出边界。\\\\n\\\\n## 成本账与条件变化\\\\n\\\\n成本至少有六类：计算含乘加、归约、激活和三角值；访存含有效元素字节、重复读取、布局转换与实际事务；通信含 split-K\\\", \\\"excerpt_ranges\\\": [[8000, 10236]], \\\"range_unit\\\": \\\"related_chapter\\\", \\\"content\\\": \\\"[EXCERPT extracted-character range 0:2236]\\\\n# K-HW-010：CPU GEMM/GEMV：寄存器、缓存与线程划分\\\\n\\\\nCPU 线性层的核心问题是如何让同一份权重或激活在较近的存储层被多次使用，同时让足够多的独立乘加处于执行中。GEMV、小批 GEMM 和大 prefill GEMM 的重用条件不同，不能仅靠增加线程数统一处理。\\\\n\\\\n## 从 shape 决定主要资源\\\\n\\\\n采用 Y=XW，X 为 M×K、W 为 K×N。M=1 时，每个权重通常只贡献一次乘加；若权重远大于末级缓存，读 sKN 字节做 2KN FLOP，主项算术强度约 2/s。多个 token 合为 M 行后，同一权重可以服务 M 行，理想强度随 M 增大，但输入、输出与分块重复流量仍要计算。\\\\n\\\\n设定 K=N=4096、FP32 权重，权重大小为 64 MiB。M=1 的乘加主项为 33,554,432 FLOP；若实测可用内存带宽假设为 80 GiB/s，仅一次权重读取的理想下界是 0.78125 ms。M=32 的主项为 1,073,741,824 FLOP，输入输出各 0.5 MiB，理想强度约 15.75 FLOP/byte。带宽下界不是预测总延迟，计算峰值、缓存、归约、线程启动和额外副本还可能支配执行。\\\\n\\\\n## 分块如何把重用落到层级\\\\n\\\\n寄存器块持有一个 mᵣ×nᵣ 输出片段，沿 K 更新。每次取一组输入与权重，更新多个独立 accumulator，减少输出反复读写并隐藏算术依赖延迟。寄存器块过大又会导致 spill，或没有空间保存地址、输入和 epilogue 临时量；更大的 tile 不必然更快。\\\\n\\\\n外层块把输入和权重的 panel 分别放入合适的 cache。选择 m𝒸、n𝒸、k𝒸 时，除了 panel 字节，还要为输出片段、预取和同核其他工作留空间。cache 容量约束与 TLB 可覆盖的页集合是两条不同约束。大 stride 的子矩阵即使有效元素不多，也可能访问很多页；把它打包成连续 panel 可以同时改善向量加载和地址翻译局部性。[Goto 作者稿](../sources/S-GOTO.md) §3–6 系统分析了层级分块、打包和这类约束，具体缓存参数仍需来自目标机器。\\\\n\\\\n打包本身是读写和布局转换。设打包花费 Tₚ，每次调用减少 ΔT，计划重用 R 次；只有 RΔT>Tₚ 时才在所计时间范围内划算。固定权重可以在模型加载后预打包；激活随请求变化，通常不能跨请求沿用。M=1 时为大 GEMM 准备整块激活布局可能不划算；极小矩阵也可能由打包和调用成本主导。\\\\n\\\\n## 向量通道、尾部与累加链\\\\n\\\\n向量化首先需要连续或可经济重排的数据。若沿 N 方向向量化，每个向量 lane 对应不同输出通道，沿 K 累加可避免每个输出都做一次水平归约；若沿 K 向量化则形成多条部分和，末尾需要合并。两者取舍随 W 的布局、N/K 形状和可用指令改变。\\\\n\\\\n独立 accumulator 数要足以让流水工作，但不应超过寄存器预算。乘加是否融合、累加 dtype、归约树和中间舍入共同决定数值结果。尾维可以使用掩码、尾部小内核或有定义的 padding；padding 必须与量化零、mask 和越界保护一致，不能依赖读到相邻内存。\\\\n\\\\n向量或矩阵指令的可用性是执行契约：硬件能力、操作系统保存的状态、编译目标、数据类型和布局必须匹配。模型参数使用 BF16 或 INT8，并不能证明当前执行路径真的使用对应硬件指令。需要通过构建产物、反汇编/内核记录和性能信号确认；各平台的具体指令能力应引用固定版本资料，不能把此处的抽象模型写成跨平台保证。\\\\n\\\\n## 线程沿哪个轴切分\\\\n\\\\n沿 M 或 N 切分通常可以让线程独占输出区域，避免最终归约；但输入/权重可能被多个私有 cache 重复读取。M=1 时沿 M 几乎没有并行度，沿 N 可把输出通道分给线程。若 N 也很小，只剩沿 K 分割能增加工作块，它会引入部分和工作区、同步和额外数值重排。\\\\n\\\\n输出独占还应考虑 cache line：相邻线程写不同元素仍可能共用同一行，导致一致性流量。线程分区、panel 共享与 NUMA 归属应一起设计。共享只读权重节省容量；每 NUMA 域一份打包副本可改善局部读取，但容量和启动成本增加。跨 socket 切分模型还需要显式统计跨域中间结果，而不是只把可用核数相加。\\\\n\\\\n## 小 M 与较大 M 的两组候选\\\\n\\\\n对 M=1，可以比较两条布局路径。第一条保留 K×N 行主序权重，沿 N 向量化：每次广播一个 xₖ，加载相邻输出通道的权重，各 lane 维护不同输出的累加。第二条把每个输出通道的 K 元素放成连续区域或相应打包 panel，沿 K 向量化点积，末尾合并部分和。前者减少水平归约，后者可能更适合原本 K 连续的制品或很窄的 N；两者都要计算权重读取、尾部和布局转换，不能同时取得对方的低打包成本与低归约成本。\\\\n\\\\n对 M=32 的设定，可比较共享打包权重 panel 的矩阵 microkernel，与按 M 切成若干 token 组、直接读取原布局权重的路径。前者让一个 panel 诊断：格式、执行数值、表示近似与任务质量\\\\n\\\\n先固定比较对象，再逐层定位。\\\\n\\\\n1. 用独立解码器检查同一制品 P、S、Z 的 q、w_hat，以及逻辑轴和组参数映射。失败定位格式、参数身份或加载映射，不能解释为表示近似的正常代价。\\\\n2. 用同一制品解码后的高精度算子参考与目标 kernel \\\"category\\\": \\\"related_chapter\\\", \\\"content\\\": \\\"[EXCERPT extracted-character range 0:2236]\\\\n# K-SYS-012：内存分配：地址、容量与在途所有权\\\\n\\\\n分配器管理的不只是空闲字节，还包括地址稳定性、布局约束、共享引用和异步消费者的生命期。请求完成时，逻辑状态可以终止，但它占用的物理资源不一定立即可重用。\\\\n\\\\n## 问题、不变量与设计轴\\\\n\\\\n问题：固定容量的设备内存要同时容纳生命期从\\\\\\\"模型版本\\\\\\\"到\\\\\\\"一次 kernel\\\\\\\"的多类对象，这些对象由异步执行的 CPU、设备和网络消费者访问，且其中一部分要求地址稳定。要回答的是\\\\\\\"谁在何时拥有哪段地址与物理容量，什么条件下可以重用\\\\\\\"。\\\\n\\\\n不变量：同一物理容量在同一时刻只属于一个活跃申请；预留到可读写之间不发布不完整状态；回收只在共享引用归零且全部已提交的异步访问完成之后；多步分配失败时已取得的资源全部撤销；容量账中共享引用只计一次，虚拟预留不计入物理驻留。\\\\n\\\\n成本项：内部碎片 Σ(aᵢ−rᵢ)、外部碎片、分配器保留而未使用的容量、映射与权限管理、分配/回收路径的主机时间、以及地址稳定要求对压缩和搬移的限制。\\\\n\\\\n设计轴：分配粒度（整对象 / 固定块 / 映射页）；地址连续性（物理连续 / 块表 / 虚拟连续）；池划分（按生命期 / 按对象类型 / 单一池）；回收时机（同步 / 按 stream 顺序 / 事件驱动延迟）；所有权记录（引用计数 / 代次 / 二者）。连续预分配、应用块表、虚拟地址加按需 backing 是粒度与连续性两轴上的三个点；stream-ordered 分配器是回收时机轴上\\\\\\\"按 stream 顺序\\\\\\\"的点。轴上未列点同样合法。\\\\n\\\\n## 从对象生命期划分空间\\\\n\\\\n权重通常随模型版本存在；KV 和 recurrent state 随请求或可复用前缀存在；工作区随执行阶段存在；图缓冲和通信注册区可能跨多个迭代存在。按这些生命期建池可以减少互相造成的碎片，但池之间的容量划分过硬也可能让一个池有空闲、另一个池无法推进。\\\\n\\\\n设对象 i 的申请量为 rᵢ，按分配粒度舍入后的占用为 aᵢ。内部碎片为 Σ(aᵢ−rᵢ)。外部碎片体现为总空闲足够、却没有满足连续性或映射条件的区间。allocator 保留而未给活跃对象使用的内存又是另一项；它可以加快下一次分配，但仍占物理容量。虚拟地址预留则不能直接加到物理驻留量上。\\\\n\\\\n完整峰值取 maxₜ[权重+活跃状态+可复用缓存+在途缓冲+工作区+保留池]，并避免把同一物理页在共享引用中重复计数。分别取每项最大值再相加是保守上界；只计算权重加稳态 KV 又可能漏掉最危险的过渡峰值。\\\\n\\\\n## 连续缓冲、块表和虚拟映射\\\\n\\\\n连续预分配适合已知上界、地址稳定且容量足够的对象，索引简单，但最大长度预留会浪费尚未使用的空间。应用层固定块池通过块表把逻辑序列映射到离散缓冲，便于共享与写时复制，要求消费者理解块布局。虚拟内存方案预留连续地址，逐步提供物理 backing，保留连续张量接口，但新增映射、页粒度与权限管理成本。\\\\n\\\\n[vAttention v1](../sources/S-VATTENTION.md) §5–6 展示了第三种方案。该版本获得更小页粒度还使用了驱动扩展，不能据此宣称所有 CUDA 环境都直接具备相同能力。设备支持、映射粒度和同步条件必须由目标版本确认。虚拟地址连续也不自动提供跨请求前缀共享、写时复制、跨机迁移或 SSD 换入换出。\\\\n\\\\n两种分页有不同尾部账。设定每请求全层 KV 为 128 KiB/token，应用块长 16 token，31 token 请求占两个 2 MiB 块，尾部浪费 128 KiB。另一设定是 32 层、每层 K 和 V 各 2 KiB/token，物理映射粒度 64 KiB：同一请求每层的 K/V 各需 62 KiB，也总计浪费 128 KiB。若映射粒度变为 2 MiB，每个层状态的尾部开销就大幅增加。这个算例用于显示粒度如何乘上层数与状态类型，不代表任意平台实际支持这些页大小。\\\\n\\\\n## 分配、提交和回收\\\\n\\\\n| 转换 | 必须成立的关系 |\\\\n|---|---|\\\\n| 空闲 → 预留 | 申请者独占容量预算，其他申请不能重复消费 |\\\\n| 预留 → 可读写 | 地址/块表、权限和必要初始化都已完成 |\\\\n| 可读写 → 在途 | 明确哪些 CPU、设备或网络消费者仍持有访问权 |\\\\n| 在途 → 待回收 | 不再接收新访问，但已有访问仍受保护 |\\\\n| 待回收 → 空闲 | 共享引用为零，所有相关异步访问已完成 |\\\\n\\\\n多步分配必须允许部分失败后释放已取得资源。若先更新请求页表再发现其他层无法分配，该请求不能带着不完整状态进入执行。可先预留全部必要增量，再发布新的可执行视图；失败时撤销本次预留，保留旧视图的一致性。\\\\n\\\\n同一个地址被下一代请求重用时，迟到完成事件必须仍能区分旧对象。引用计数负责“谁还可能使用”，完成事件负责“已提交的使用是否结束”；两者不可互相替代。跨 stream 的释放依赖见 [streams 与 allocator](../frameworks/streams-allocator.md)，请求取消的时序见 [资源完成](cancellation-resource-completion.md)。\\\\n\\\\n## extracted-character range 4000:6236]\\\\n| 尚未完成输入解释 | 原始字节、媒体大小及待处理工作 | 入口读取、请求准入或输入期限 |\\\\n| 已完成前处理 | token/张量字节、已保留请求数 | 前处理生产者与模型准入 |\\\\n| 已提交的一次执行 | 在途批数、借用输入与暂定状态字节 | 调度器与状态分配器 |\\\\n| 待交付输出 |
